title: अमिताभ बच्चन का ट्विटर अकाउंट किसने हैक किया
text: Amitabh ke Twitter account se Turkey aur Pakistan se jude messages post kiye gaye. Hackers ne Amitabh ke Twitter account ka profile-bio bhi badal diya. Amitabh ki profile photo ki jagah Pakistan ke Prime Minister Imran Khan ki tasveer laga di. Saath hi likha- "Actor... chalo, kuch log ab bhi aisa keh rahe hain. Pakistan ko pyaar." Amitabh Bachchan Twitter par khaas active rahte hain aur unke 3.74 crore followers hain. Halankeh baad mein Amitabh ka Twitter account recover kar liya gaya aur hackers dwara kiye gaye sabhi tweets bhi hata diye gaye. Hackers ne Amitabh ke account se tweet kiya tha, "Ye poori duniya ke liye ek zaroori message hai! Hum Turkey ke football players ke prati Iceland Republic ke ravayya ki ninda karte hain. Hum pyaar se baat karte hain, lekin hum badi si chhadi rakhte hain aur aapko yahan bade cyber hamle ke baare mein bata rahe hain. Ayildiz Tim Turkish Cyber Army." Turkey ki football team pichle din Euro 2020 ka qualifying match khelne Iceland gayi thi. Wahan pahunchne ke baad Turkey ke players ki airport par gahan talashi li gayi thi. Amitabh Bachchan ka Twitter account hack kiye jaane ke baare mein Mumbai police ke jan-sampark adhikari ne bataya ki unhone apni cyber unit aur Maharashtra cyber team ko jankari di hai. Maamle ki jaanch ki ja rahi hai. Ye bhi padhein: Amitabh Bachchan ne chukaya kisano ka karz jab saat din tak Amitabh Bachchan ne munh nahi dhoya. title: अमरीका ने उ. कोरिया के मिसाइल टेस्ट की पुष्टि की
text:
North Korea ke sarkari TV par is missile test ki tasveeren jaari ki gayi. American foreign minister Rex Tillerson ne ise America aur "duniya ke liye ek naya khatra" batate hue chetavani di hai ki America kabhi bhi ek "parmanu-less North Korea ko sweekar nahi karega". North Korea ne isse pehle, Tuesday ko kaha tha ki usne pehli baar ek intercontinental ballistic missile ka safal parikshan kiya hai. American adhikaron ka maana hai ki North Korea ab Alaska tak missile hamla kar sakta hai. Halankeh visheshagyon ka kehna hai ki iska nishana sahi nahi ho sakta.

North Korean missile se America ko kitna khatra hai, North Korea ka ICBM missile parikshan ka dawa North Korea ke missile test ki khabar aane ke kuch hi ghante baad America ne United Nations Security Council ki aapat meeting bulane ki maang ki. Samjha jaata hai ki Wednesday 5 July ko band kamre mein 15 sadasyon wali council ki ek meeting karvayi jaayegi. American foreign minister ne is baare mein ek bayan jaari kiya hai jismein likha hai, "America North Korea ke intercontinental ballistic missile test karne ki kadi ninda karta hai. Is missile ka parikshan karne se America, hamare sahyogiyon, is kshetra aur saari duniya ke liye khatra aur badh gaya hai." Unhone zor diya ki is "vishv khatre ko rokne ke liye vishv action kiya jaana zaroori hai". Unhone chetavani di ki aisa koi bhi desh jisne North Korea ko aarthik aur sainik madad di ho ya jisne United Nations Security Council ke prastaav ko poori tarah se palan na kiya ho, wo "ek khatarnaak shasan ki madad kar raha tha aur uske saath mila hua tha".

North Korean TV ka kehna hai ki Kim Jong Un ne missile test ka nirikshan kiya. North Korea ne kya kaha tha? North Korea ke sarkari television ke mutabik, North Korean president Kim Jong Un ki maujoodgi mein Hwasong-14 missile ka parikshan kiya gaya. Ismein ye bhi bataya gaya ki missile 2,802 kilometer ki doori tay karne mein kamyab raha aur samundar mein target ko nishana banane se pehle unse 933 kilometer ki doori bhi tay ki. Ye pehla mauka hai jab North Korea ne intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) ki safaltapoorvak parikshan karne ka dawa kiya hai. North Korea ka dawa hai ki is missile ke zariye wo ab America ke zameeni ilaake tak maar karne mein saksham ho gaya hai.

Intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) kya hai? Lambi doori tay karne wala missile, jo khas taur par parmanu hathiyar ke liye design kiya jaata hai. Is missile kam se kam 5,500 kilometer tak nishana laga sakta hai aur nishana lagane se pehle ye 10 hazaar kilometer ki doori tay kar sakta hai. North Korea ne do tarah ke intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) ka display kiya hai - pehla to KN-08 hai, jiska range 11,500 kilometer hai aur doosri missile ka range 10,000 kilometer hai. title: कमला हैरिस के शपथ ग्रहण के साथ क्या अमेरिकी राजनीति में भारतीय और अहम हो जाएंगे?
text: Kamala Harris ke pita Jamaica se America aaye the. Unka naam Donald Harris tha. Unki maa Shyamalan Gopalan ek Bharatiya-American thi. Unka janm Chennai mein hua tha. Donald Harris 1964 mein America aaye the. Iske ek saal ke baad 1965 mein apravartan aur rashtriyata kanoon parit hua. Is kanoon ke tahat janm ke bajaye kaam ke aadhar par nagrikta dene ka pravadhaan hai. Iske baad Asia se badi sankhya mein log America aane shuru ho gaye. America mein Bharatiya Americans ki sankhya 1957 mein Dalip Singh Saund pehle Bharatiya American the jo American pratinidhi sabha ke liye chune gaye the. Uske baad se Piyush 'Bobby' Jindal aur Pramila Jayapal jaise kai log American pratinidhi sabha ke liye chune gaye. Samapt Bharatiya-American logon ki aabadi America ki kul aabadi ka sirf 1.5 percent hai. American janganna ke aankdon ke mutabik saal 2000 mein America mein 19,00,000 Bharatiya rah rahe the jo saal 2015 tak lagbhag dogune hokar 39,82,000 ho chuke the. America mein Bharatiya log na sirf ek prabhavi apravasi samuh ke taur par hain balki doosre apravasi samuhon ki tulna mein inki shaikshanik prishthbhoomi bhi achhi hai. Think tank Pew Research Center ke mutabik America mein rehne wale 40 percent Bharatiyon ke paas masters ki degree hai aur Bharatiyon ki kul aabadi ka sirf 7.5 percent aabadi garibi rekha se neeche rah rahi hai jabki Americans ki 15.7 percent aabadi garibi rekha se neeche rahi hai. Saalani gharelu aay $73,060 sabhi Asian-American $100,000 sabhi Bharatiya-American lekin bada sawal yeh hai ki kya itni kam sankhya mein hone ke bawajood ve American rajneeti ko prabhavit kar sakte hain? Ise samajhne ke liye humein yeh jaanne ki zaroorat hai ki Bharatiya-American waqai mein kaise vote karte hain. Bharatiya-American matdataon ka vivaran America mein 40 lakh Bharatiya-American aabadi rahti hai. Yeh America mein Mexico ke baad sabse adhik tezi se badhti hui apravasi aabadi hai. American janganna ke aankdon ke mutabik saal 2000 aur 2018 ke beech Bharatiyon ki aabadi mein 137.2 percent ki vriddhi hui hai. Inmein se zyada tar New York, Chicago, San Jose aur San Francisco jaise mahanagaron mein rahte hain. Sirf New York mein hi chhe lakh se zyada Bharatiya rahte hain jabki Chicago mein do lakh se zyada Bharatiya rahte hain. Pew Research ke mutabik lekin jab baat America se bahar janm liye yogya votaron ki aati hai tab Bharatiya-Americans ki Mexico aur Philippines ke logon ke baad teesri sabse badi tadad hai. Saal 2016 mein hue ek survey (NAAS post-election) se pata chalta hai ki 48 percent Bharatiya-American Democrat hain ya phir Democratic party ki or unka rujhan hai. Sirf 22 percent Bharatiya hi Republican hain. President chunav nazdeek aate hi Republican aur Democratic party ke beech Bharatiya votaron ko apni or karne ko lekar hod mach jaati hai. Pichle kuch dashkon mein yeh trend dikha hai. Aakhir iski wajah kya hai? Bharatiya-American votaron ki kade muqabale wale rajyon Florida, Pennsylvania aur Michigan mein majboot maujoodgi hai. Yeh rajya chunavon mein natije ko palatne ki kshamata rakhte hain. Indian-American Attitude Survey (IAAS) ke haal ke survey ke mutabik 70 percent se zyada American Bharatiyon ne November mein hue chunav mein Trump ke muqable Joe Biden ko tarjeeh dene ke sanket diye the. H1B visa - Trump vs Biden Bharatiya duniya mein sabse zyada H1B visa rakhne wala samudaay hain. Ise vaishvik sandarbh mein dekhe to saalani 85,000 jaari hone wale H1B visa ka 70 percent visa Bharatiyon ke paas hai. Lekin chunav ke theek pehle Trump ne Bharatiyon ke 'American sapne' ko jhatka de dala. Pichle saal ki shuruaat mein American naukriyon ko 'bachane' ke liye Trump ne ek aadesh par hastakshar kiye the. Yeh aadesh sanghiy agencies ko videshiyon ko naukri dene par pabandi lagata hai. Khaaskar H1B visa par aaye logon ko. Yeh IT mein kaam karne wale un logon ke liye ek jhatke ki tarah tha jo har saal is visa par America aate hain. Iska asar September mein hue AAPI ke survey mein dikha jab 35 percent Asian-Bharatiyon ne Trump ko President ke taur par dekhna napasand kiya. Ab bahut saare Bharatiya chunav mein vijeta rahe Joe Biden ki or ummeed se dekh rahe hain kyunki unhone pichle saal Bharat ke swatantrata divas ke mauke par H1B visa ko lekar kaha tha ki, "Mera dil aap un sabhi logon ke saath hai jo ghrina ke shikar bane hain. Apravartan ko lekar jinhe mushkilein jhelni pad rahi hain. Ismein dashkon se jaari us H1B visa ko lekar achanak se liya gaya faisla bhi shamil hai jisse America ab tak majboot banta raha hai." Isse pehle 84 percent Bharatiya-Americans ne chunav mein Obama ko vote kiya tha. Democrats alpsankhyakon aur apravasi logon ke prati Republican ki tulna mein zyada naram rahe hain. Aur ab Kamala Harris ke upraashtrapati banne ke saath hum aur bhi kai Bharatiya mool ke Americans ko America ki nayi sarkar mein ahem zimmedariyan nibhate hue dekh sakte hain. title: उत्तर-पूर्वी श्रीलंका में भीषण संघर्ष जारी
text: Sena ka kehna hai ki Somvaar ko Mulaitivu zile mein hue sangharsh mein kam se kam 36 Tamil vidrohi maare gaye hain. Is beech Antarraashtreey Red Cross Committee (ICRC) ne kaha hai ki sangharsh kshetra mein fanse aam nagrikon ke liye khane-peene ke samaanon ko lekar ek aur jahaz wahan pahunch gaya hai. Haal ke mahino mein Sri Lanka ki sena aur Tamil vidrohi ke beech jaari sangharsh mein sena ne vidrohiyon ke kai thikano ko apne qabze mein kar liya hai. Ab Tamil vidrohi jungle ke chhote se ghere aur Mulaitivu zile ke tatīyal ilaake mein hi simte hue hain. Anumaan ke mutabik sangharsh kshetra mein 70 hazaar se do laakhon ke beech nagrik fanse hue hain. Pichle 25 varshon se Tamil vidrohi ek alag rajya ki maang ko lekar Sri Lanka mein sangharsh kar rahe hain. Sangharsh kshetra mein nagrik ab tak is yudh mein 70 hazaar se zyada log maare ja chuke hain. Sena ka kehna hai ki Mulaitivu mein Tamil vidrohiyon ke bache thikano par sena qabza karna chaah rahi hai is wajah se Uttar-Poorvi Sri Lanka mein sangharsh aur bhi bhishan ho gaya hai. Sena ne Puthukudieruppu ilaake mein Tamil vidrohiyon ke kai thikano ko nasht kar diya hai. Sena ke pravakta Udaya Nanayakkara ne BBC ko bataya, "Sangharsh ke baad sena ne Puthukudieruppu ilaake mein ek kilometer kshetra mein phale Tamil vidrohiyon ke bunker ko apne qabze mein kar liya hai." Tamil vidrohiyon se abhi sampark nahi ho paya hai aur kisi svatantra srot se sena ke vaktavyon ki pushti nahi ho payi hai. Uttar-Poorvi kshetra mein sena aur vidrohiyon ke beech jaari is sangharsh ke beech sangharsh kshetra mein fanse hazaron aam nagrikon ki sthiti ko lekar antarraashtreey star par chinta jatayi ja rahi hai.

title: फांसी मिलेगी आसिया को पर डरा हुआ है परिवार
text: Halaanki Paigambar Mohammad ke apmaan ke aarop ka wo purzor khandan karti hain, lekin Pakistan mein sirf Eesh-ninda ka aarop hi saza-e-maut ka kaaran ban jaata hai. Itna hi nahi us vyakti ke poore parivaar ko nishana banaya jaata hai. Isliye Asia Bibi ke pati aur unke paanch bachche pichhle paanch saalon se jagah badal badal kar chhupte fir rahe hain. BBC samvaaddata Shaima Khalil ke saath ek sakshatkaar mein unke pati Ashiq Masiha ne antarraashtreey jagat se madad ki appeal ki hai. Samapt Masiha ne kahte hain, "Humein maut ki dhamki mil rahi hai. Hum chhup kar rah rahe hain. Hum kisi ek jagah par zyada samay tak tik kar nahi rah sakte hain. Lambe samay tak dar ke saaye tale jeena aasaan nahi hai." Aroop unki chaudah saal ki beti Eeshan kehti hain, "Log hamari aankhon ke saamne meri maa ko maar rahe the. Jab maine unhe bachane ki koshish ki to un logon ne mujhe bhi maarne ki koshish ki." Ve aage batati hain, "Shuru mein to main nahi samajh paayi ki kya ho raha hai, lekin baad mein logon ne mujhe Eesh-ninda kaanoon ke baare mein bataya." Isai mahila Asia Bibi ko Punjab ki adalat ne Eesh-ninda kaanoon ke tahat maut ki saza sunai hai. Ek Muslim mahila ke saath baatcheet ke dauraan Asia Bibi ke upar Paigambar Mohammad ke baare mein aapattijanak tippani karne ka aarop hai. Asia Bibi ke vakilon ne Supreme Court mein faisle ke khilaf appeal ki hai. title: विजय माल्या का दावा, देश छोड़ने से पहले वित्त मंत्री अरुण जेटली से मिला था
text: Unhone kaha hai ki 2016 mein Bharat chhodne se pehle wo vitta mantri se mile the. Mallya London ke ek court mein pratyakshan maamle mein sunwai ke liye aaye the. Bharatiya agencies ne Mallya ke pratyakshan ki maang ki hai. Westminster court parisar mein Mallya ne ek sawaal ke jawab mein samvaaddataon se kaha, "Main Bharat se Geneva ek pehle se tay meeting ke liye gaya tha. Jaane se pehle maine vitta mantri se mulaqat ki thi." Halankeh vitta mantri Arun Jaitley ne Mallya ke daave ko kharij kar diya hai. Unhone 'Factual Situation' shirsak se Facebook par post likhi hai aur kaha hai ki Mallya ke daave mein koi sachai nahi hai. Mallya ne daava kiya, "Yeh pehle se tay meeting thi aur banks ke settlement ke baare mein phir se peshkash ki. Yahi sachai hai." Jab Mallya se yeh pucha gaya ki Bharat ke vitta mantri se unki mulaqat kahan hui thi to unhone kaha, "Main aapko kyun bataun. Yeh puchh kar mujhe pareshan na karein." Vitta mantri ne unse kya kaha is baare mein Mallya ne kuch nahi kaha. Mallya ke bayan par Bharat ke vitta mantri Arun Jaitley ne Facebook par post kar apna jawab diya. Jaitley ne kya kaha? "Yeh tathyaatmak roop se galat hai aur yeh sach ko nahi darshata hai. 2014 se maine kabhi unhe mulaqat ka waqt nahi diya hai, aise mein mujhse milne ka sawaal hi nahi uthta. Halankeh wo Rajya Sabha ke sadasya the aur kabhi-kabhi sadan mein bhi aaya karte the. Aise mein us visheshadhikar ka durupayog karte hue jab main sadan ki karyavahi ke baad apne kamre ki aur ja raha tha to wo meri aur aaye aur chalte chalte kaha "Main karz chukta karne ka ek offer de raha hoon." "Unke pehle bhi diye gaye is tarah ke jhanse se main avagat tha isliye maine aage kisi bhi baat ke karne se inkaar karte hue unse kaha, "Mujhse baat karne ka koi fayda nahi hai, aapko bank ko offer dena chahiye." "Maine unke haath mein pade kagaz ko lene se bhi inkaar kar diya. Is ek vaakya ke alawa jo unhone Rajya Sabha sadasya hone ka fayda uthaate hue mujhse kaha, taaki unhe bank ke karzdar hone mein vyavsayik labh mil sake, unhe meeting ke liye mulaqat ka waqt dene ka sawaal hi nahi uthta." Mallya ke pratyakshan par faisla 10 December ko London ki Westminster magistrate court mein pichle 18 mahino se chal rahi Vijay Mallya ke pratyakshan ki sunwai poori ho gayi hai aur adalat is par apna faisla 10 December ko sunaegi. Mallya ke bayan par pratikriyaayein Vijay Mallya ka bayan aane ke baad rajneetik galiyon mein kai pratikriyaayein aayi. Congress ke varishth neta Abhishek Manu Singhvi ne kaha hai ki is poore maamle ki jaanch ki jaani chahiye. Wahi Congress neta Randeep Singh Surjewala ne tweet kiya ki Vijay Mallya vidaai lekar desh ka paisa lekar bhage hain. Unhone likha ki sarkar chauki daar nahi, bhaagidar hai. Dilli ke mukhyamantri aur Aam Aadmi Party ke neta Arvind Kejriwal ne tweet kiya, "Vitta mantri ne ab tak is baat ko kyun chhupaya. Yeh hairaan karne wali baat hai." Kejriwal ne yeh bhi likha, "Desh chhodne se pehle Nirav Modi ki Pradhan Mantri se meeting aur Mallya ki vitta mantri Arun Jaitley se meeting se kya prove hota hai, yeh log jaana chahte hain." Vijay Mallya ke is bayan se ek baar fir BJP sansad Subramanian Swamy ka wo tweet charcha mein aa gaya jisme unhone likha tha ki "Mallya desh nahi chhod sakte kyunki desh ke havai adde par unke khilaf look out notice jaari ho chuka tha. Iske baad wo Dilli aate hain aur kisi aise powerful shakhs se milte hain jo unke khilaf jaari look out notice mein badlav kar usse Bharat chhodne se rokne ki jagah sirf uski reporting ke aadesh mein tabdeel karwa dete hain. Wo shakhs kaun hain jisne notice ko kamzor kiya? Is par Bharat ke purv vitta mantri aur videsh mantri rahe Yashwant Sinha ne tweet kiya ki na sirf vitta mantri balki poore BJP ko Vijay Mallya ke saath sambandh par sab kuch sach sach batana hoga. CPM neta Sitaram Yechury ne kaha ki is tathya ko to hum sab pehle se jaante the. Unhone kaha, "Sarkar chahe jitna bhi inkaar kare lekin yeh to tay hai ki banks se karz ke roop mein logon ka paisa lekar bhagne waalon mein se ek bhi shakhs bagair sarkar ki jaankari ke desh nahi chhod sakta tha." Bharatiya banks ke karzdar Bharat sarkar ka kehna hai ki Mallya Bharatiya banks ke 9 hazaar crore rupaye se adhik ke karzdar hain. Mallya March 2016 mein Britain aa gaye the aur tab se London mein reh rahe hain. Bharat sarkar Britain se unke pratyakshan ki koshish mein lagi hui hai. Bharat aur Britain ne 1992 mein pratyakshan sandhi par dastakhat kiye the, lekin iske baad se sirf ek hi vyakti ka pratyakshan kiya ja saka hai. title: दिशा रवि को बेल देते हुए जज ने कहा- असहमति राजद्रोह नहीं है
text: Police ne Disha Ravi ko Dilli ki ek adalat mein pesh karte hue kaha tha ki "Disha Ravi toolkit Google document ki editor hain aur is document ko banane aur ise prasarit karne mein unki mukhya bhumika hai." Disha Ravi par lage aropon par Additional Session Judge Dharmendra Rana ne kaha, "Mujhe nahi lagta ki ek WhatsApp group banana ya kisi hani na pahunchane wale 'toolkit' ka editor hona koi jurm hai." Unhone kaha, "Is kathit toolkit ya PJF (Poetic Justice Foundation) se link ko aapattijanak nahi mana gaya hai, isliye sirf WhatsApp group par un chat ko hatane, jinka toolkit aur PJF se sambandh hai, uska koi matlab nahi reh jata." Court ne kya kaha? Samachar agency PTI ke mutabik court ne kaha ki sanchar ko lekar koi bhaugolik badha nahi hai aur ek nagrik ne paas maulik adhikar hai ki wo uplabdh sadhan ka istemal communication bhejne ka prapt karne ke liye kar sakta hai. Samapt judge ne kaha ki ye swabhavik hai ki Ravi kisi tarah ke vivaad se door rehna chahti thi. Iske alawa court ne kaha ki Ravi ka PJF ke Khalistani samarthak karyakartaon se sambandh ke bhi koi saboot nahi hain. Court ne kaha ki is baat ke bhi koi saboot nahi mile hain 26 January ko hui hinsa ka sambandh Ravi ya PJF se hai. Judge Dharmendra Rana ne Ravi ko ek lakh ke personal bond par zamaanat di. Unhone kaha, "Record mein kam aur adhoore sabooton ko dhyan mein rakhte hue mujhe 22 varshiya ladki, jiska koi aparaadhik itihas nahi hai, wo zamaanat ke niyam todgi, iska bhi thos kaaran nahi mil raha hai." Judge ne kaha ki tathakathit 'toolkit' se pata chalta hai ki isse kisi bhi tarah ki hinsa bhadkaane ki koshish nahi ki gayi thi. Unhone kaha, "Mere khayal se nagrik ek loktantrik desh mein sarkar par nazar rakhte hain. Sirf isliye ki wo rajya ki neetiyon se asahmat hain, unhe jail mein nahi rakha ja sakta. Rajdroh ka arop isliye nahi lagaya ja sakta ki sarkar ko usse chot pahuncha hai." Court ne kaha ki matbhed, asahmati, alag vichar, asantosh yahan tak ki asvikriti rajya ki neetiyon mein nishpakshta laane ke liye zaroori upkaran hain. Adalat ne kaha, "Ek jagruk aur mukhar nagrikta ek udasin ya vinamra nagrikta ki tulna mein nirvivad roop se ek swasth aur jeevant loktantra ka sanket hai." "Samvidhan ke Anuchhed 19 ke tahat asantosh ka adhikar dridhta se nihit hai." Disha ko jaanch mein sahyog karne ka nirdesh iske alawa court ne kaha ki is baat ke bhi koi saboot nahi mile ki Ravi ne toolkit paryavaran karyakarta Greta Thunberg ko bheja aur isse duniya ke dusre logon tak alagavadi vichar faila. Court ne ye bhi kaha ki wo is baat ko samajhte hain ki is tarah se kisi aparaadhik ke liye saboot ikattha karna mushkil hai. "Mujhe is tathya ke baare mein bhi pata hai ki jaanch abhi shuruaati daur mein hai aur police aur saboot ikattha karne ki prakriya mein hai. Jaanch agencies ne maujood sabooton ke aadhar par (Ravi ko) giraftar kiya lekin ab unhe mahaj shak ke aadhar par kisi nagrik ki svatantrata ko pratibandhit karne ki anumati nahi di ja sakti hai." Adalat ne Ravi ko nirdesh diya ki wo jaanch mein sahyog karna jaari rakhein aur adalat ki anumati ke bina wo desh se baahar na jaayein. Adalat ne kaha ki hinsa mein shamil 100 se zyada logon ko Dilli police ne giraftar kiya hai, aur unse puchtaach ki ja rahi hai, lekin Ravi ka sambandh hinsa ke kisi aparaadhi ke saath hai, abhiyaojan paksh par ise record par nahi la paaya hai. Kaun hain Disha Ravi Bengaluru ki 22 varshiya paryavaran karyakarta Disha Ravi ki giraftari ne paryavaran sanrakshan ke liye kaam karne wale yuvaon ke beech dar ka mahaul paida kar diya hai. Disha Ravi 'Friday for Future' naamak muhim ki sansthapak hain. Unhe Dilli police ki special cell ne 13 February ko Bengaluru se giraftar kiya tha. Court mein Ravi ko pesh karte hue police ne apne bayaan mein kaha tha ki "Disha Ravi toolkit Google document ki editor hain aur is document ko banane aur ise prasarit karne mein unki mukhya bhumika hai." "Is silsile mein unhone Khalistan samarthak 'Poetic Justice Foundation' ke saath milkar Bharatiya rajya ke prati vaimanasy failane ka kaam kiya aur unhone hi Greta Thunberg ke saath ye toolkit share kiya tha." Disha par Bharatiya dand sanhita ke antargat rajdroh, samaj mein samudayon ke beech nafrat failane aur aparaadhik shadyaantr ke maamle darj kiye gaye. Disha ne 'Friday for Future' ki shuruaat tab ki thi, jab 2018 mein Greta Thunberg ne apne paryavaran bachao abhiyan se duniya bhar mein halchal macha di thi. title: स्मिथ और वार्नर पर 'लाइफ़ बैन' का ख़तरा
text: South Africa ke khilaf aakhri Test se Smith aur unke Warner ke nilabhan ke baad ab ye kaha ja raha hai ki Cricket Australia apni aachar sanhita ke tahat dhokhadhaadi ke liye Smith aur Warner par umr bhar ke liye pratibandh laga sakta hai. Ek or jahan dakshin Africa ke khilaf Australia bhari haar ki taraf badh rahi hai to doosri taraf Steven Smith aur David Warner ke liye ghar mein mushkilein badhti hui dikh rahi hain. Haalaat ki gambhirta ka andaaza is baat se bhi lagaya ja sakta hai ki Pradhan Mantri Malcolm Turnbull ne apni narazgi jahir ki aur Cricket Australia ke mukhya karyakari adhikari James Sutherland ne sarvajanik taur par maafi maangi hai. Pradhan Mantri ka bayan Pradhan Mantri Turnbull ne kaha, "Hum sabhi South Africa se aa rahi khabron se niraash hain. Is par yakeen karna mushkil lag raha hai ki Australia ki cricket team cheating mein shamil rahi hai. Hamare cricketer hamare role model rahe hain aur cricket ko bhadra logon ka khel maana jaata hai." Unhone kaha, "Hamari team is tarah se kaise dhokhadhaadi mein shamil ho sakti hai. Maine Cricket Australia ke chairman David Peever se baat ki hai. South Africa mein jo kuch hua hai, use lekar maine unhe saaf taur par apni niraasha aur chinta prakat ki hai. Mujhe ummeed hai ki Cricket Australia jald hi koi mahatvapurn kadam uthaayega." Cricket Australia ke pramukh James Sutherland ne kaha, "Ye Test match jaari rehna chahiye aur interim taur par is maamle mein jis shighrata ki zarurat hai, hum maamle ki jaanch jaari rakhenge." Sutherland ne kaha, "Cricket Australia aur Australian cricket ke fan desh ki numaindagi karne wale cricket khiladiyon se niyat maanak ka palan karne ki apeksha karte hain aur is baar iska dhyan nahi rakha gaya hai." "Hamari tarah Australia ke sabhi log jawab chahte hain aur hum is maamle mein prathmikta ke aadhar par apni jaanch ke natije ke baare mein aapko jankari dete rahenge." Smith aur Warner ka nilamban ball tampering vivaad ke baad Australia ke captain Smith South Africa ke khilaf jaari teesre Test ke baaki dinon mein captaincy nahi karenge. Upcaptain David Warner ko bhi hatna pada hai. ICC ne Smith ko ek Test ke liye nilambit kar diya hai. Steve Smith ne shanivaar ko kaha tha ki team ke 'leadership group' ne ball tamper karne ki yojana ke baare mein baat ki thi. Australian batsman Cameron Bancroft ne gend ko tamper kiya tha. Cape Town mein khele ja rahe teesre Test ke baaki din Australia ki captaincy Tim Paine karenge. Halankeh, Smith aur Warner bator khiladi team ka hissa bane rahenge. Cape Town Test mein ravivaar ko chauthe din ka khel jaari hai. ICC ne Australian captain Steve Smith par gend se chhedkhani ke is maamle mein ek match ka nilamban aur match fees ka 100 percent jurmana laga diya hai. Australian salami batsman Cameron Bancroft par match fees ka 75 pratishat jurmana laga gaya aur unhe teen demerit ank bhi diye gaye hain kyunki un par ICC ki aachar sanhita ke level do ke ullanghan ka aarop tha. Australia aur South Africa ke beech kheli ja rahi maujooda series lagataar vivaad mein rahi hai. Series ke pehle match mein Australia ne 118 run se jeet darj ki thi. title: 11 दिसंबर के बाद सिद्धू को मिल सकती है बड़ी भूमिका: नज़रिया
text: Siddhu ko Congress president Rahul Gandhi ka vishwas hasil hai aur chunavon ke dauran Congress ke star pracharaks ke roop mein Rahul aur Sonia Gandhi ke baad sabse zyada unhi ki demand rehti hai. Prachar ke liye Siddhu ki demand Congress Working Committee ke sadasyon, All India Congress Committee ke Mahasachivon aur Congress ke shasan wale rajyon ke mukhyamantriyon se bhi zyada hai. Inmein Amarinder bhi shamil hain, jinka Punjab se bahar bahut kam prabhav hai. Dusre shabdon mein kahen to Patiala ke is dilkash ballebaaz ka samay achha chal raha hai aur umeed hai ki 2022 ke aaspaas ya usse pehle hi unhe Punjab mein badi bhumika mil sakti hai. Punjab mein 2022 mein vidhan sabha chunav honge. Bhale hi kabhi party anushasan, shalinata aur rajneetik maryadaon ki maheen Lakshman rekha ka ullanghan ho jaye lekin Siddhu shabdon se khelna bakhoobi jaante hain. Isliye unka Amarinder Singh ko abhibhavak, margdarshak aur neta batana apne shabd wapas lene ya maafi maangne ke bajaye aatmiya sambandh jodne wala nazar aaya. Kartarpur ke hero saabit hue Siddhu Kartarpur Sahib corridor khulne ke ghatnakram se pehle Amarinder jahan udasin se nazar aaye wahin Siddhu kaafi sakriya rahe. Siddhu mein Rahul aur Congress ko aisa neta mila hai jo Akaliyon aur Amarinder dono se badhkar saabit hua hai. Sikho ke beech Siddhu Kartarpur ke asli hero hain. Haal hi mein paanch rajyon ke vidhan sabha chunavon ke dauran Siddhu ne joshila abhiyan chala kar Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi aur anya virodhiyon par nishana saadha. 11 December tay karega Siddhu ka bhavishya Sonia Gandhi aur Rahul Gandhi ne Siddhu ko Captain Amarinder Singh ki marzi ke khilaf us samay party mein jagah di thi, jab unka BJP aur Aam Aadmi Party ke saath molbhav sire nahi chadh paya tha. Agar aane wale 11 December ko party Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Mizoram aur Telangana mein behtar pradarshan karti hai to Punjab ki rajneeti mein thodi halchal ho sakti hai. Congress mein jab bhi kisi kshetriya neta ki chhavi badi hone lagti hai aur wah svatantra roop se kaam karna shuru karta hai, party high command doosri pankti ke leadership ko ubharna shuru kar deta hai. Sonia aur Rahul bhale hi Indira aur Rajiv ki tarah manmarzi se kam hi kaam karte hain lekin 11 December ke baad agar Congress do-teen rajyon mein jeet jaati hai to isse Rahul Gandhi ka kad aur prabhav badhega. Rahul ke uday se Chandigarh mein bhi unke vishwasth log ubharenge, jahan party aur sarkar 76 saal ke aise Captain ke netritv mein kaam kar rahi hai jinki chhavi 'ji huzoori' na karne wale mukhyamantriyon ki hai. Saal 2014 mein hue Lok Sabha chunavon ke baad Congress mein Rahul ke netritv mein badlav ka daur chal raha hai. Rahul rajyon mein yuva aur apni pasand ka netritv dekhna chahte hain. Rajasthan mein Sachin Pilot, Madhya Pradesh mein Jyotiraditya Scindia aur Telangana mein Mohammad Azharuddin iske udaharan hain. Kamal Nath, Ashok Gehlot, Ahmed Patel aur Amarinder Singh jaise party ke diggaj ab party ke liye taakat ke bajaye zarurat zyada ban gaye hain. Agar pradarshan theek nahi raha to... lekin agar 11 tareekh ko pradarshan theek nahi raha (agar Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh aur Telangana mein Congress sarkar nahi bana payi ya keval Rajasthan hi jeet payi) to Amarinder Singh ko Siddhu ki raftaar rokne ka mauka mil jaayega. Rahul ko bhi majboori mein madad aur salah wagairah ke liye 2019 tak ya iske baad bhi Amarinder Singh ya unke jaise diggajon par aashrit rehna padega. Amarinder Singh ke samarthak agar Gandhiyon ki netritv shaili par nazar daalenge to samajh jaayenge ki jab-jab netritv parivartan hua hai, kai mukhya kirdaron ne khud ko hashiye par paaya hai. Indira Gandhi ne un sabhi ko kinare kar diya tha jinhe Jawaharlal Nehru ke aankh-kaan kaha jaata tha. Indira ko yeh pasand nahi tha ki koi unhe yeh kehata rahe ki aisa karo, waisa karo. Aise hi jab Rajiv Gandhi ne 1981-82 mein Sanjay Gandhi ki jagah li, unhone apne bade bhai ki team ke kai logon ko apne liye 'bemel' paakar kinare kar diya. Jaise hi Rajiv Mahasachiv niyukt hue the, Yuva Congress ke shaktishaali pramukh Ram Chandra Rath ka prabhav tezi se kam ho gaya tha. Rajiv Gandhi ki hatya ke baad unke uttaradhikari P.V. Narasimha ne M.L. Fotedar jaise Rajiv ke kai sahyogiyon ko hata diya tha. Usi tarah jab Sitaram Kesari Congress ke adhyaksh bane to turant hi Janardan Pujari, Bhuvanesh Chaturvedi aur Rao ke anya kareebiyon ko jaana pada. Jab Sonia ne adhyaksh pad sambhala to Rajiv, Narasimha ya Kesari ke kareebi samjhe jaane wale kai neta bahar ho gaye. Congress pramukh ke taur par Sonia ko anushasan lagu karne ke maamle mein thoda naram mana jaata hai lekin unke andar mushkil haalaton ko paar karne aur gathbandhan ke netaon ko jodne ki achi kshamata thi. Neetiyon ke maamle mein unka jhukav center se thoda left ki taraf raha hai. Wahin Rahul ko Rajiv aur Sanjay ki shaili wale neta ke roop mein dekha jaata hai jo spashtvadi hain aur faisle lene se bhi nahi hichakte. Rahul ke sudharon, shahrik matdataon, takneek aur yuvaon ko zyada prathmikta dene se party ke kai neta aur kshetrapal ya to khud ko badalne ke liye majboor honge ya phir unhe party chhodkar jaana padega. title: सऊदी अरब, बहरीन और सूडान ने ईरान से तोड़े रिश्ते
text:
Saudi Dootawas mein hue virodh pradarshan ke baad 40 logon ko giraftar kiya gaya. Saudi Arab mein Shia dharmguru Nimr al Nimr ko saza-e-maut diye jaane ke baad dono deshon ke sambandh kaafi tanavpoorn ho gaye hain. Iran mein pradarshankariyon ne Tehran sthit Saudi Arab dootawas mein aag laga di thi. Saudi Arab ke saath-saath uske sahyogi desh Bahrain aur Sudan ne bhi Iran se sambandh tod liye hain jabki Sanjukt Arab Amirate ne Iran se apne kuch rajneetik wapas bula liye hain. Isse pehle Iran ke shreshth dharmik neta Ayatollah Ali Khamenei ne Sheikh Nimr ko saza dene par teekhi pratikriya vyakt ki hai. Unhone kaha hai ki Saudi Arab ko iske liye 'daiviya pratishodh' ka samna karna padega. Khamenei ne tweet kar kaha, "Mare gaye dharmguru ne na kabhi logon ko hathiyaarband aandolan ke liye uksaya, na hi wo kisi saazish ka hissa rahe." Unhone aage likha, "Sheikh Nimr ki galti sirf itni thi ki wo mukhar alochak the." Khamenei ke mutabik, "Nimr al Nimr ka khoon anuchit tareeke se bahaya gaya. Iska asar jald hi hoga aur Saudi Arab ko 'Allah ke khar' ka samna karna padega." 

Dusri or, pradarshankariyon ne Tehran mein Saudi Arab ke dootawas mein ghus kar imarat ko aag laga di. Pradarshankariyon ne Saudi dootawas ke bahar Saudi ke sultan ki tasveerein jalai. Pradarshankari dobaara imarat ke saamne ikattha hue. Jis sadak par Saudi Arab ka dootawas hai, uska naam Iranian adhikaarion ne al Nimr ke naam par rakh diya hai. Dusri taraf, Nimr al Nimr ko maut ki saza diye jaane par America ne kaha hai ki isse nasli tanav badhne ka khatra paida ho gaya hai. Bahrain aur anya deshon mein bhi virodh pradarshan hue. Washington sthit Saudi Arab maamlo ke visheshagya Simon Henderson ne kaha, "Ve koi bandookdhari nahi the. Ve ek tez tarraar neta the aur vastav mein is par vivaad hai ki ve ek khaas tarah ke tez tarraar aadmi the." Ve aage kehte hain, "Ve koi bandook rakhne wale ya aise shakhs nahi the jo kahin bomb laga dein. Lekin ve Saudi Arab mein rehne wale Shiaon ka zabardast samarthan karte the. Unhe lagta tha ki ve Saudi Arab mein doyam darje ke nagrik hain."

title: टीम अन्ना ने लगाई राजनीति में छलांग
text: Anna Hazare ne desh mein ghoomkar 'logon ko jagane' ki baat kahi hai. Pichle nau dinon se anshan par baithe Team Anna ke mukhya sadasya Arvind Kejriwal ne kaha ki aandolan pehle charan se nikal kar ab doosre charan ko pahunch gaya hai. Anna Hazare ke bhrashtachar virodhi aandolan ke mukhya karta-dharta Arvind Kejriwal ka kehna tha, "Ab sarkar ko girane ka waqt aa gaya hai. Hamara dal poore desh ka daura karega aur janta hamare netaon ka chunav karegi. Lekin agar sarkar Lokpal kanun pass kar deti hai to humein rajneeti mein aane ki koi zarurat nahi hogi." Arvind Kejriwal aur unke kai saathi 23 July se hi anshan par maujood the. Lekin sarkar ne unse baatcheet ki koi pehal nahi ki thi. Guruvar ko Arvind Kejriwal ka swasthya kaafi gir jane ki khabrein thi. Shaam ke samay Anna Hazare ne ghoshna karte hue kaha ki agar janta ki marzi hogi to wo ek rajneetik dal ka gathan karenge. Kejriwal ne kaha ki wo sarkar ke saamne nahi jhuke hain balki ab sansad ke bheetar jaakar poori vyavastha se ladenge aur usmein badlav ki koshish karenge. Bharman baad mein Dilli ke Jantar Mantar ke manch se hi bolte hue Anna Hazare ne kaha ki wo aane wale dheedh saal mein poore desh ka bharman karenge aur logon ko jagayenge. Kuch log keh rahe hain ki unhe pata tha ki Hazare ki team aakhirkar rajneeti mein hi utregi. Unke jawab mein Anna Hazare ka kehna tha ki pehle to kaha ja raha tha ki agar unhe vyavastha mein badlav chahiye to sansad mein aaye, aur jab unhone faisla le liya hai to fir sawaal kyun uthaye ja rahe hain. Halankhi Team Anna mein rajneetik dal banaye jaane ko lekar matbhed hain. Karnataka ke purv Lokayukt Santosh Hegde aur Narmada Bachao Andolan ki Medha Patkar ne rajneetik dal banaye jaane ke virodh mein bayan diya hai.

title: 'एक महीने बाद भी समझ नहीं आ रहा जीएसटी'
text: Halaanki lagu hone ke baad se ab tak GST par sab kuch saaf nahi hai. Bazaar jaane wale logon ko abtak yeh samajh nahi aa pa raha hai ki iske lagu hone se kya sasta hua hai aur kya mehnga? Thok mandiyan veeran padi hui hain. Khudra vikreta abhi GST ka software lagane mein vyast hain. Kharidari karne wale log bhi abhi tak samajh nahi paa rahe hain ki GST ke aane se unke budget par kya farq pada hai. Modi ne GST par kya kaha? Do din mein GST samjhane wale GST mein uljhe hain. Vyapari Purani Dilli ki Khari Baoli mein aaj utni bheed nahi thi jabki Rakhi ka tyohar bas kuch hi dinon mein aane wala hai. Is khudra mandi ke vyapar mandal ke Bharat Arora batate hain ki aisa pehli baar hua hai jab mandi ki zyada tar aadhatein khaali padi hui hain. Arora kehte hain, "Saare vyapari GST ke chakkar mein lage hain. Koi 'software engineer' ke chakkar laga raha hai to koi 'chartered accountant' ke. Humein abhi tak yeh samajh nahi aa raha hai ki kya hone wala hai. Waise GST ke tahat jo kar pranali tayar ki gayi hai usme kai khamiyan hain. Misal ke taur par khudra chawal par koi kar nahi hai, wahi agar pack kar use becha jaye to uspar GST lagu hoga. Kai aur masle hain jo 'processed' khane se sambandhit hain, unpar bhi asamajh bana hua hai." Sarkar aur kisaan, dono pareshan! Kharid kshamata mein aayi kami. Vyapariyon ka kehna hai ki kai aisi khadya samagriyan hain jinpar pehle koi kar nahi tha magar ab unpar 5 percent se lekar 12 percent tak kar lagaya gaya hai, iski wajah se logon ki kharidne ki kshamata mein kami aayi hai. Magar tax expert Devendra Kumar Mishra maante hain ki GST ka lagu hona bahut aadharbhut parivartan hai. Unka maana hai ki shuruaati daur mein kathinai isliye ho rahi hai kyunki yeh vyavastha poori tarah takneek par aadharit hai. Mishra kehte hain, "Yeh nayi vyavastha ka pehla mahina hai. Log ise samajhne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Ise lagu karne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Yahi wajah hai ki unhe thodi pareshani ka samna karna pad raha hai. Waise 'excise duty' aur 'VAT' yaani 'value added tax' ko milakar GST banaya gaya hai. Iski chaar daren nirdharit ki gayi hain. Sarkar ke liye bhi yeh bada prayog hai. Sab 'wait and watch' ki mudra mein hain." Kya Bharat ki growth ki raftaar barkarar rahegi? Ja rahi hain naukriyan. Yeh bhi kaha ja raha hai ki GST ki wajah se vyapariyon par atirikt bojh pada hai jise paatne ke liye unhone yahan kaam karne walon ki sankhya mein kami karni shuru kar di hai. Purani Dilli ho ya Nayi Dilli ke bade bazaaron ke showroom aur dukaanon mein kaam karne wale, logon ki naukriyan bhi ja rahi hain. GST wahi, soch nayi! title: अमरीका के टेक्सस में हुई गोलीबारी में पाकिस्तानी छात्रा की मौत
text: Houston se lagbhag 50 kilometer door Santa Fe High School mein hui goli-baari mein 10 logon ki maut hui aur itne hi log ghayal bhi ho gaye. Is ghatna ke baad sandigdh hamlaavar ke roop mein school ke hi ek 17 varshiya chaatra Dimitrios Pagourtzis ko hirasat mein liya gaya hai. Washington DC mein Pakistan ke dootawas ne pushti ki hai ki maare gaye chaatron mein Pakistan ki Sabika Sheikh bhi shamil hain. Marne walon mein ek adhyapika bhi hain jinka naam Cynthia Tisdale bataya gaya hai. Tisdale ke kareebi rishtedaron ne is samachar ki pushti ki hai. America ke school mein goli-baari, das ki maut America: school mein goli-baari, 17 ki maut Pakistani chaatra 18 varshiya Sabika Sheikh ek exchange student ke taur par America gayi hui thi. Unhe Kennedy-Lugar Youth Exchange and Study Abroad Program (YES) ke tahat bheja gaya tha. Yeh program America ke videsh mantralay ki taraf se chalaya jata hai. Isse 11 September, 2001 mein hue hamlon ke baad shuru kiya gaya, jiska maksad Muslim bahul rashtra aur America ke beech sanskritik aadan-pradaan karna hai. Sabika ke mata-pita Farah Sheikh aur Abdul Aziz ne BBC ko bataya ki unhe is goli-baari ke baare mein TV ke zariye pata chala. Unhone bataya ki school prashasan se baat karne par unhone ek ghante ke andar beti ki maut ki pushti kar di thi. Unki beti ka sharir agle hafte unke ghar Karachi bhej diya jayega. Is hamle mein marne walon mein zyada tar chaatra bataye ja rahe hain, jinki shinaakht Texas ke adhikaarion dwara shanivaar ke baad karne ki ummeed hai. Sandigdh hamlaavar Dimitrios Pagourtzis ko hatya ke arop mein giraftaar kar liya gaya hai. Unke paas kathit taur par unke pita ki license wali shotgun aur ek revolver thi. Hamle ke samay kya hua tha? Chaatron ka kehna hai ki shukravar subah 8 baje (Bhartiya samay anusar dopahar 1 baje) se thoda pehle hamlaavar ne ek art class mein pravesh kiya aur goli-baari shuru kar di. Us samay school mein 1,400 chaatra maujood the. Brena Quantinella naam ke ek chaatra ne samachar agency AP ko bataya ki Pagourtzis class mein aaye aur unhone ek chaatra par nishana saadhte hue kaha ki "Main tumhe maarne ja raha hoon." Is dauran jab Quantinella wahan se bachkar bhaagne lage to unke pair mein chot lag bhi gayi. Mahilayein kam karti hain goli-baari ke aparadh police ko sandigdh ki diary, computer, mobile se bhi kai ahem jaankariyan mili hain. Jinse pata chala hai ki hamlaavar ne hamle ki yojana banayi aur hamle ke baad woh khud ko bhi maarna chahta tha. Texas ke governor Greg Abbott ne kaha ki hamlaavar kishor ne khud ko police ke hawaale kar diya kyunki usmein aatmahatya karne ki himmat nahi thi. Abbott ne yeh bhi kaha ki school se kai tarah ke visphotak bhi baramad kiye gaye hain. Yeh school Houston se lagbhag 65 kilometer door sthit hai. Unhone aage bataya ki unmein ek "CO2 device" aur "Molotov cocktail" bhi shamil hai. Gun Violence Archive ke monitoring group ke anusar, America mein goli-baari ki ghatnaon se is saal ab tak 5,000 se adhik log maare ja chuke hain. Ab kaise hain haalatein school ke paas ek khule maidan mein saankhdo ki sankhya mein log shukravar shaam ikattha hue. BBC samvaddata Paul Black ne bataya ki wahan maujood logon ke roone ki aawaz ki wajah updeshakon aur rajneetaon ki aawaz dheemi pad gayi. White House mein ek karyakram ke dauran President Donald Trump ne is hamle ko "bahut hi bhayankar" bataya hai. Unhone kaha, "Mere adhikari woh sab kuch karne ke liye tayaar hain jisse chaatron aur schools ki suraksha sunishchit ki ja sake. Iske saath hi jo log hathiyaaron ke dam par khud ke liye aur doosron ke liye khatra paida kar rahe hain unke khilaf bhi kadam uthaaye ja rahe hain." White House ki taraf se jaari bayan mein bataya gaya is saal ki shuruaat mein Florida mein hui goli-baari ki ghatna ke baad jo 'White House School Safety Panel' banaya gaya tha, usne kaam karna shuru kar diya hai aur agle hafte uski baithak ho sakti hai. Governor Abbott ne is goli-baari ko "sabse zyada jaghny hamlon mein se ek bataya, jise Texas schools ke itihas mein kabhi nahi dekha gaya". Is beech Houston Texans NFL team ke ek athlete JJ Watt ne peediton ke antim sanskar mein hone wale kharchon ko uthane ki peshkash ki hai. Kya antar tha is baar ki goli-baari mein? America ke Florida rajya ke Parkland ke ek school mein hui goli-baari mein kam se kam 17 logon ki maut hui thi, is hamle ko sabse ghatak ghatna bataya gaya tha. Iske baad America mein schools mein bandook niyantran ka rashtriya abhiyan chalaaya gaya. Halankeh bandook par niyantran ke pakshadhar logon ne in chhote-chhote badlavon ki alochana ki hai, unka kehna hai ki kai bade rajneeta NRA ka samarthan karte hain. America ke itihas school mein hui goli-baari mein sabse badi ghatna saal 2007 mein Virginia Tech vishwavidyalay mein hui thi, is goli-baari mein 33 log maare gaye the aur 25 ghayal ho gaye the. Washington Post ke ek vishleshan ke anusar is saal American sena ki tulna mein American schools mein hui goli-baari mein zyada mautien hui hain. Kaun hai hamlaavar? Adhikaarion ke anusar 17 varshiya Dimitrios Pagourtzis ke dastavezon se pata chala hai ki unhone hamle ke baad khud ko maarne ki yojana bhi bana rakhi thi. Sandigdh hamlaavar Dimitrios Pagourtzis Governor Abbott ne samvaddataon ko bataya ki Parkland aur Sutherland mein hui goli-baari ki pichhli ghatnaon ki tarah is baar adhikaarion ko kisi tarah ki poorv soochna ya chetavani nahi di gayi. Pagourtzis ne social media par ki gayi post mein khud ko ek athlete bataya hua hai aur likha hai, "Mujhe rajneeti pasand nahi." 30 April ko unhone ek T-shirt ki photo share ki hai, jis par likha hua tha "Born to Kill". Pagourtzis ko filhal Galveston jail mein rakha gaya hai aur un par hatya ka maamla darj kiya gaya hai. America ke ek school mein fir chali goliyan.

title: 'लाभ के पद' को लेकर राजनीति तेज़
text: Ek aur jahan vaampanthii dalon ne Guruvaar ko saamaajik roop se 'laabh ke pad' sambandhi sanshodhit vidheyak ka samarthan kiya, toh doosri aur BJP ne chunaav aayog se isse sambandhit shikayaton par jald karvaai ki maang ki. Gauratlab hai ki Rashtrapati Kalam ne is vidheyak ko punarvichar ke liye wapas bhej diya tha. Shukravaar ko mantrimandal ki baithak mein is par vichar kiye jaane ki sambhaavna hai. CPM mahaasachiv Prakash Karat ne patrakaaron se baat karte hue kaha, "Sarkar ko vidheyak ko sanvidhaanik prakriya se guzarne ke baad wapas bhej dena chahiye." CPI mahaasachiv AB Bardhan Rashtrapati Kalam ki aapatti se apni asahmati pehle hi jata chuke hain. Unka kehna hai ki rajyon ki laabh ke pad ki alag paribhashaen hain. Vaampanthii dalon ki dikkat yeh hai ki laabh ke pad ko lekar unke kai sansadion ki shikayatein chunaav aayog ko ki gayi hain. BJP ki maang idhar BJP is avsar ko haath se nahi jaane dena chahti. Party ne Budhwaar ko chunaav aayog ko ek gyaanapan saunp diya jisme maang ki gayi hai ki laabh ke padon par baithe 46 sansadion ke khilaaf daayir yaachikaon par turant nirnay liya jaaye. CPM ne BJP ki maang ki alochana ki hai. CPM mahaasachiv Prakash Karat ka kehna tha ki BJP ne mauka dekh kar chunaav aayog se karvaai tez karne ki maang ki hai. Unka kehna tha ki chunaav aayog ko is maamle mein jaldbaazi nahi dikhani chahiye. Isse pehle Kaanoon Mantri Hansraj Bhardwaj ne patrakaaron se baat karte hue kaha tha ki Sansad ne jis vidheyak ko paarit kiya, usmein koi kami nahi hai. Lekin Rashtrapati ne use wapas kiya hai toh us par punarvichar kiya jaayega. Pradhan Mantri Manmohan Singh ne bhi Budhwaar ko isi silsile mein Rashtrapati APJ Abdul Kalam se mulaqat ki thi. Rashtrapati Kalam ne vidheyak ko wapas karte hue kaha tha ki kaun se pad laabh ke pad ki paridhi mein nahi aate hain, ise tay karte waqt nishpakshata ka dhyan rakhna chahiye. Saath hi yeh bhi dhyan rakha jaana chahiye ki kendr sarkar dwara paarit yeh vidheyak sabhi rajyon aur kendr shasit pradeshon mein bhi samaan aur paardarshii tareeke se lagu ho sake.
reference: 'लाभ के पद' संबंधी विधेयक को लेकर राजनीति तेज़ हो गई है.

title: अब कौन लगाएगा 'अदीबों की अदालत'?
text: Rachna jagat ki kai vidhayon mein apna khaas aur prabhavi dakhal rakhne wale Kamleshwar BBC Hindi ke pathakon aur shrotaon se bhi jude rahe. Chahe wo patrakarita ki kaljayi parampara ko samajhne ki koshish rahi ho ya phir Taslima Nasreen ke paksh mein bebaki se ki gayi tippani, Kamleshwar samay-samay par BBC ke zariye logon se mukhatib hote rahe hain. Sabse badi baat to yeh hai ki Kamleshwar ki rachnadharmita ko kisi ek sanche mein nahi kasa ja sakta hai. Wo ek collage ki tarah hi hai. Usmein alag-alag rang dekhne ko milte hain. Patrakar, patkatha lekhak, samikshak, kathakar...na jaane kitni hi bhumikaayein aur sabhi mein ek khaas pehchaan, ek majboot pakad aur zamini samajh. Kamleshwar ke lekhan ka parichay kuch aisa hi hai. Film jagat, Doordarshan, sahityik patra-patrikaayein, samachar patra aur aise bahut saare kshetron mein apni rachnatmakta ka pramaan diya hai Kamleshwar ne. Dainik Jagran aur Dainik Bhaskar jaise samachar patraon mein sampadak ke taur par unhone kaam kiya aur saath hi us samay Doordarshan ko unhone disha di jab Bharat mein doosra aur koi television channel nahi hua karta tha. Alvida... Aadeeb ek aur jahan Kamleshwar apni kalam se gambhir vimarsh kuredete nazar aate hain wahi lokpriya aur aam logon ki ruchi wale sahitya mein bhi inka khaasa dakhal raha. Iska pramaan yeh hai ki jis khubsurti se wo 'Kaali Aandhi' jaisa sahitya logon ko dete hain, usi paripakvata ke saath film jagat ko Kamleshwar se kai achhi patkathayein bhi milti hain. Laghukathao par to Kamleshwar ka vishesh kaam raha hai aur khud likhne se lekar nai kahani ke astitv ka jhanda buland karne tak unki badi bhumika rahi hai. 'Sareeka' ka sampadan karte hue katha sahitya ko ek vistaar dena iski ek banagi hai. Aadeebon ki adalat ki baat karta unka upanyas 'Kitne Pakistan' ho ya phir Bharatiya rajneeti ka ek chehra dikhati film 'Aandhi' ho, Kamleshwar ka kaam ek maanak ke taur par dekha jaata raha hai. Sahitya jagat ko apne yogdaan ke liye Bharat sarkar ne unhe varsh 2006 mein Padma Bhushan samman se sammanit kiya. Sahitya Akademi ne unhe unke upanyas, 'Kitne Pakistan' ke liye 2003 mein Akademi Award se sammanit kiya tha.

title: पाकिस्तान की राजनीति किस ओर?
text: Lekin is saari pareshani ki wajah kya hai? Do baar Pradhan Mantri rah chuke Nawaz Sharif kuch mahine pehle lage aapaatkaal ke dauran barkhast kiye gaye Supreme Court aur High Court ke judges ki bahali ke mudde par yeh rukh apna rahe hain. Pakistan mein har koi is par sahmat hai ki November 2007 mein lagaye gaye aapaatkaal ke dauran President Pervez Musharraf ne jis tarah se Supreme Court aur High Court ke judges ko hataaya tha wo poori tarah se asanvidhanik tha. Khud Pervez Musharraf bhi yeh sweekar kar chuke hain. February 2008 mein hue aam chunavon ke baad Benazir Bhutto ki Pakistan Peoples Party aur Nawaz Sharif ki PML (Nawaz) ke beech sarkar banane ke liye isi baat par samjhauta hua tha ki loktantrik tareeke se chuni gayi sarkar in barkhast kiye gaye judges ko bahal kar legi. Asal mudda hai Supreme Court ke barkhast mukhya nyayadhish Iftikhar Chaudhry ki bahali. Jis waqt Iftikhar Chaudhry Supreme Court ke mukhya nyayadhish the us samay Pakistan mein Pervez Musharraf desh ki bagdour sambhale hue the. Us dauran Iftikhar Chaudhry ne Supreme Court ke mukhya nyayadhish ke taur par apne faislon mein Pakistan ki suraksha agency ISI par hi sawaal khade karne shuru kar diye the. Iftikhar Chaudhry ne kuch laapata hue logon ke maamle ki sunwai karte hue ISI se talab kar liya tha ki yeh laapata log kis tarah se kathit taur par aatankwadi bataye gaye the. Iftikhar Chaudhry ne President Pervez Musharraf ke dobaara President banaye jaane ko chunauti dene wale maamlon ki bhi adalat mein sunwai ko manzoori de di thi. Aur yahi baat Pakistan ki sena ki aankh mein sabse badi kirkiri saabit hui. Kya sochte hain log? November 2007 mein President Pervez Musharraf ne Pakistan mein aapaatkaal laga kar Supreme Court aur High Court ke judges ko barkhast kar diya tha. Waise Iftikhar Chaudhry ke alochak kehte hain ki unhone rajneeti karne ki koshish ki. Lihaza unko barkhast kiya jana sahi hai lekin, Chaudhry ke samarthak maante hain ki unhone Pakistan ke sainya shasan ke khilaf khade hone ki himmat dikhayi thi. Iftikhar Chaudhry ke samarthakon ka kehna hai ki ab agar Chaudhry ko bahal kiya jata hai to isse sanket milega ki Pakistan mein kanoon vyavastha poori tarah azaad hai. Supreme Court Bar Association ke adhyaksh Tariq Mahmood maante hain, "Agar humne Iftikhar Chaudhry ke maamle mein samjhauta kiya to samajh lijiye ki humne apne usoolon se samjhauta kar liya." "Hum yeh kaise manzoor kar sakte hain ki aap kuch judges ki to bahali kar dein lekin mukhya nyayadhish ko bahal na karein. Yeh bilkul bhi manzoor nahi hoga." Judges ki bahali February 2008 mein hue aam chunavon ke dauran Iftikhar Chaudhry ki dobaara bahali ek bada mudda tha. Poorv Pradhan Mantri aur apni party PML (N) ke chairman Nawaz Sharif ne to judges ki bahali ke mudde par hi chunav lada tha. Nawaz ki party ke sansad Ayaz Amir kehte hain, "Yeh hamari party ki saakh ki baat hai, humne logon se wada kiya hai. Humne Pakistan mein ek svatantra nyaypalika dene ki baat ki hai. Hum samjhauta kaise kar sakte hain." Nawaz Sharif ko is mudde par Pakistan mein kaafi samarthan aur wah-wah bhi mili. Nawaz ki kamiyabi ka andaaza is baat se lagaya ja sakta hai ki Pakistan Peoples Party ke karwahak adhyaksh aur Benazir Bhutto ke pati Asif Ali Zardari ko sarkar banane ke liye Nawaz Sharif se haath milana pada. Nawaz Sharif ne sirf ek maang rakhi thi aur wo yeh ki barkhast kiye gaye tamaam judges ki dobaara bahali ho. Kya sochte hain Musharraf? President Pervez Musharraf poorv mukhya nyayadhish Iftikhar Chaudhry ki bahali ke khilaf hain. Musharraf ko dar hai ki Chaudhry ke fir se mukhya nyayadhish ki kursi par baithte hi Supreme Court unke fir se President chune jaane ko asanvidhanik karar de sakta hai ya phir November mein Pakistan mein lagaye gaye aapaatkaal ko bhi gairkanuni karar diya ja sakta hai. Nawaz Sharif to kehte hain ki Pervez Musharraf par kanooni tareeke se mukadma chalaakar doshi thahraya jana chahiye. Pakistan mein President Pervez Musharraf kamzor dikhai dete hain lekin wo ab bhi kursi chhodte dikhai nahi dete. Sutron ke anusar Pervez Musharraf apne adhikaron mein katoti karne ke liye tayyar hain lekin wo chahte hain ki Pakistan ke mukhya nyayadhish ke adhikaron mein bhi kami ki jaye. Rajneetik galiyon mein aisi charcha hai ki Pervez Musharraf ki peeth par haath rakhne wala America aur Pakistani sena bhi kuch isi tarah ki vyavastha chahte hain. Kya chahti hai PPP? Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) bhi Pakistan mein kisi tarah ke rajneetik sankat ka khatra mol lena nahi chahti. Pakistan ki soochna mantri Sherry Rehman kehti hain, "Hum nahi chahte ki Pakistan ek baar fir sanvidhanik sankat mein fass jaye. Isse sthirta hi khatre mein pad jayegi." Sherry Rehman maanti hain ki yeh badlav ka daur hai aur shaantipurn parivartan se yeh masla bhi hal ho jayega lekin kai log maante hain ki isi shaantipurn parivartan ke kaaran hi Pakistan mein sainya shasan ke baad loktantra kayam hua hai. Waise logon ka yeh bhi maanana hai ki yeh saara kuch paschimi deshon ki banai gayi rananiti ke tahat hi hua tha aur isi rananiti ke tahat hi Benazir Bhutto Pakistan wapas aayi thi. Kya koi sauda ho gaya hai? Benazir Bhutto aur tatkalin sainya pramukh Pervez Musharraf ke beech ek sauda ho gaya tha jiske tahat Pakistan ki sainya sarkar ne Bhutto par lage bhrashtachar ke tamaam aarop wapas le liye the. Musharraf ne apni senachalak ki vardi chhod di thi aur Pakistan mein svatantra aur nishpaksh chunav ko manzoori de di gayi thi. Wahin, kuch logon ka yeh bhi maanana hai ki Asif Ali Zardari ne President Musharraf aur Nawaz Sharif se alag-alag tarike se baatcheet ki hai. Halankeh, Asif Ali Zardari ne BBC ko diye ek interview mein kaha tha ki jab wo 1990 ke dashak mein hatya aur bhrashtachar ke maamle mein jail mein the us samay Iftikhar Chaudhry ne unke khilaf ek abhiyan chala rakha tha. Dusri taraf, Asif Ali Zardari judges ki bahali ko lekar katibaddh hain lekin, unhe samajh mein nahi aa raha hai ki wo is pareshani ka hal kis tarah se nikaalein. Wahin, Pervez Musharraf ke khilaf aandolan jaari rakhne wale vakilon aur samajik karyakartao ki nazar mein yeh koi masla hi nahi hai. Dono hi maante hain ki President Pervez Musharraf ne gairkanuni aur asanvidhanik tareeke se kaam kiya hai lihaza unhe parinaam bhugatne honge. Yeh maante hain ki mukhya nyayadhish ne usoolon par aadharit kadam uthaya tha isliye unhe bahal kiya jana chahiye lekin rajneetik galiyon mein yeh charcha zoron par hai ki ab oont kis karvat baithega. Aisa faisla karna bada hi mushkil hoga jo sabhi ko manzoor ho.

title: एड्स पर बीबीसी हिंदी के रेडियो कार्यक्रम
text: Desh ke alag-alag hisson se Vinita Dwivedi ki reports... Benson aur Bensi ki kahani AIDS ki bimari yun to kisi ko bhi ho sakti hai lekin jin bachchon ko ye bimari maa-baap se virasat mein mili ho unka ye sawaal bhi sahi hai ki ismein unki kya galti hai? Ye kahani hai Kerala ke Kovalam zile ke Kaithakuzhi gaon ki saat saal ki Bensi aur paanch saal ke Benson ki jo maa-baap ki wajah se AIDS ka shikar hue. In bachchon ke saath samaj ka bartav achha nahi raha hai... Condom ke istemal se parhez haal mein hue ek survey se ye pata chala hai ki Bharat mein AIDSgrast logon mein se 80 pratishat ko ye rog asurakshit yaun sambandhon se hota hai. Iske bawajood Bharat mein log aam taur par condom ke istemal se katarate hain. Bharatiya samaj mein santan rokne ke liye bhi condom ki jagah nasbandi hi zyada pasand ki jaati hai. Aakhir kyun hai aisa... Kamathipura ki yaunkarmiyon ki vyatha aam taur par veshyalaon ko AIDS failane ke kendra ke roop mein dekha jaata hai. Ye dharna kyun hai iska pata Mumbai ki yaunkarmiyon ke sabse bade kendra Kamathipura se chala. Andhra Pradesh se aaye Kamathi mazdooron ke naam par basa ye ilaaka unneesvi sadi ke ant tak yaunkarmiyon ka sabse bada thikana ban gaya tha... Sonagachi ke veshyalaon mein jagrukta Bharat mein dehvyapar ke sabse bade ilaake Kolkata ke Sonagachi mein yaunkarmi mahilaon ki jagrukta AIDS ke khilaf unki ladai mein vardaan saabit ho rahi hai. Ye mahilayein is baat ka pratik ban gayi hain ki kis tarah jagruk aur sangathit hokar ve condom ke istemal ko badhava de sakti hain. Sonagachi ki yehi kahani... AIDS-peedit Naveen ki mushkilein Dilli nivasi Naveen teen varsh se AIDSgrast hain. Maa-baap ne ghar se nikaal diya. Bhai-bhabhi baat nahi karte. Ek ke baad ek kai bimariyan ho jaati hain. Dawa ka kharch badh gaya aur bahar nikalna band ho gaya. Ab to beti ko school mein dakhila bhi nahi mil raha hai kyunki uske maa-baap ko AIDS hai. Log kiraye par ghar dene mein bhi aanakani karte hain... Mazdooron aur drivers mein jagrukta kitni HIV-AIDS ka virus koi bhed nahi karta hai fir wo chahe purush, mahila ya bacche hi kyun na hon. Yaane ameer-gareeb se lekar anpadhon tak sab iska shikar ho rahe hain. Magar isse grast hone ki sabse zyada sambhavna maani jaati hai mazdooron ya apna ghar chhodkar kaam karne baahar gaye logon mein. Kitni jagrukta hai unmein... AIDS ke prati doctors ka ravayya AIDS ki bimari ne bhi Bharatiya samaj ke kai pehluon par se parda utha diya hai, bahut si sharmnaak paratein kholi hain. Inmein se ek hai AIDS ke rogi ko nazarandaaz karte doctors. Doctori ka kaam shuru karne ke saath hi kasam khai jaati hai ki har zaruratmand ka bina shart aur bina bhedbhaav ilaj karenge. Magar kya aisa ho paa raha hai... Mumbai ka JJ hospital khoon mein AIDS ke virus HIV ki jaanch ho jaane ke baad ye zaroori hota hai ki mareez ko sahi jankari di jaaye aur ilaj ka tareeqa bataya jaaye kyunki HIV ke rogi ko aksar hospital jaana padta hai. Is tarah ilaj lamba khinchta hai. Mumbai ka aisa ek hospital jahan badi sankhya mein HIV AIDS ke rogi aate hain... Neem-hakeemon ke chakkar mein log Bharat mein bahut tarah ki paramparik chikitsa paddhatiyan prachalit hain aur har tarah ki bimari ke ilaj ke liye unka sahara liya jaata hai. Magar AIDS ka ilaj kisi ke paas nahi hai. Phir bhi gareeb, ashikshit aur anjaan log neem-hakeemon ke paas jaane se katarate nahi hain. Nateeja ye ki ilaj ke bajaye unki jeb khaali ho jaati hai... Anti-retroviral dawaen Anti retroviral dawaen HIV virus ke asar ko kam kar sakti hain. Ye dawaen virus ko sharir mein failne se rokhti hain aur isse maut ko na sirf varshon ke liye tala ja sakta hai balki isse rogi ki takleef bhi kam hoti hai. Magar Bharat jaise vikasheel deshon mein ye dawa muft uplabdh nahi hai aur keemat kaafi hai... Bihar ki AIDS peedit ek mahila ki kahani AIDS se judi kai aisi kahaniyan hain jo dakiyaanoos samaj ke chehre par pade naqab ko hataati hain. Aisi hi ek kahani hai ek mahila ki jo duniya walon ke dar ki wajah se apna naam tak batane ko raazi nahi hain. Yehi nahi unhe apni nanhi si bachchi ko apne se milon door rakhna pad raha hai, bachchi bhi AIDS se grast hai... AIDSgrast samalingi America mein 1980 ke dashak mein samalingik purushon mein sabse pehle AIDS ki bimari paayi gayi aur kuch samay tak yehi maana jaata raha ki ye keval samalingikon ki bimari hai. Magar dheere-dheere sachai saamne aayi. Bharat mein samalingik sambandhon ko manata nahi di jaati to aise mein AIDS jagrukta ki kaun kahe... AIDS peedit mahila Tamil ki kahani kehti hain ki auraton mein purushon se kahin zyada sahanshilta hoti hai aur zindagi kai baar aise waqye pesh bhi karti hai. Aise mein ek Tamil ek aisi mahila hain jinke jeevan ne unki kadi pariksha li hai. AIDS ne unke pati aur bacche ke saath hi poore parivaar ko chheen liya. Maa-baap tak ne unka saath nahi diya. Unki himmat ki dastaan...

title: अब उत्तर कोरिया क्यों गए दक्षिण कोरियाई राष्ट्रपति
text: Moon Jae-in apni patni Kim Jung-sook ke saath teen divasiya yatra ke liye Mangalvaar ki subah Pyongyang pahunche, jahan Kim Jong-un ne apni patni Ri Sol-ju ke saath unka swagat kiya. Is saal Uttar Korea ne America aur Dakshin Korea dono hi deshon se baat ki thi, lekin ye baatein kuch khaas sarthak hoti nazar nahi aayi. Ab is vartaa ke zariye Dakshin Korea America-Uttar Korea ke beech madhyasth ki bhumika nibhata hai. Pichle ek dashak mein aisa pehli baar ho raha hai jab koi Dakshin Koreai neta Uttar Korea ke daure par hai. Dakshin Koreai rashtrapati Moon Jae-in ka swagat karte Uttar Koreai shasak Kim Jong-un, kya hoga agenda? Is daure mein dono deshon ke netaon ke beech khaas mudda ye hoga ki kin vyavaharik kadmon ko uthaakar Koreai prayaadweep mein parmanu khatre ko kam kiya ja sakta hai. Lekin ye kadam kya honge aur iski barikiyan kya hongi iski koi jankari saamne nahi aayi hai. Dakshin Korea ke liye do khaas mudde ho sakte hain. BBC Seoul samvaddata Laura Bicker ke mutabik, "Is saal April mein dono Koreai netaon ne pehli baar mulaqat ki thi. In netaon ki mulaqat khud mein ek behad bada kadam tha. Ab rashtrapati Moon ka maksad is yatra mein Uttar Korea se parmanu nishastrikaran ke mudde par baatcheet ko aage badhana hoga." Dakshin Korea beech bachav ko tayaar, unhone aage kaha, "Agar aisa nahi hota hai to antar-Koreai summit aur Singapore mein American rashtrapati Donald Trump aur Kim Jong-un ki mulaqat ek chamakdaar photo event ban kar reh jaayegi. Sambhav hai ki American neta bhi Uttar Korea ko lekar apna sanyam khone lagte hain." April mein hui in Koreai netaon ki mulaqat ke baad kai aise parivaron ko milaya gaya jo deshon ki seemaon ke karan bant gaye the. Sudharenge America-Uttar Korea ke rishte? Uttar Korea kai tarah ke antarraashtreey pratibandhon ko jhel raha hai. Dakshin aur Uttar Korea ke beech kisi bhi naye aarthik sahyog ke liye ye zaroori hai ki Uttar Korea par lage pratibandhon mein dheelaai ki jaaye. Ye pratibandh tabhi kam ho sakenge jab America aur Uttar Korea ke beech hui vartaa ko gati mile. Singapore mein hui mulaqat ke dauran Uttar Koreai shasak Kim Jong-un aur American rashtrapati Donald Trump is saal June mein American rashtrapati Donald Trump aur Uttar Korea ke shasak Kim Jong-un ke beech aaitihasik mulaqat hui thi. Is mulaqat mein Uttar Korea ne parmanu hathiyaar nashht karne ko lekar apni pratibaddhata jatayi thi. title: भारतीय रुपया क्या बांग्लादेशी टका से भी पिछड़ा? फ़ैक्ट चेक
text: Social media par viral screenshot Facebook aur Twitter par aise saikron posts maujood hain jinmein yeh daawa kiya gaya hai ki '72 varshon mein pehli baar Bharatiya rupya Bangladeshi taka se pichhda hai'. Inmein se adhikansh logon ne Bharatiya currency ki is dasha ke liye Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi aur unki sarkar ko dosh diya hai. Bahut se logon ne social media par currency rate aur rupya-taka mein tulna karne wale kuch graphs bhi post kiye hain. Lekin apni padtaal mein humne paya ki yeh daawa galat hai aur currency rate wale graphs is daawa se ulat kahani kahte hain. Actress Richa Chadha ne yeh tweet kiya tha jise baad mein unhone hata diya. Rupya aur taka Bangladeshi aur Bharat ki stock exchanges se prapt vittiya jankariyon ke aadhar par taka aur rupya ka conversion rate dikhane wali kuch public websites ke anusar Mangalvaar ko ek Bharatiya rupye ki tulna mein Bangladeshi taka ki keemat 1.18 taka ke barabar hai. Matlab ek Bharatiya rupye mein Bangladesh ka 1.18 taka kharida ja sakta hai aur dus Bharatiya rupye mein 11.80 Bangladeshi taka. Agar is sthiti ko palat kar dekha jaye toh Mangalvaar ke rate par ek Bangladeshi taka mein sirf 84 paise hi milenge aur dus Bangladeshi taka mein 8.46 Bharatiya rupye. Social media par bhi log wahi conversion rate post kar rahe hain, lekin ek Bangladeshi taka ke saamne .84 Bharatiya rupya keemat dekhkar use videshi mudra ki tulna mein kamzor bata rahe hain. Dollar ke muqabale... Bangladesh ki Dhaka Stock Exchange aur Chittagong Stock Exchange ke anusar Mangalvaar ko ek American dollar ki keemat 84.60 Bangladeshi taka ke barabar hai. Jabki Bharat ke National Stock Exchange aur Bombay Stock Exchange ke mutabik Mangalvaar ko ek American dollar ki keemat 71.70 Bharatiya rupye ke barabar hai. Matlab Bangladeshi taka ki tulna mein filhal kam Bharatiya rupye kharch karke adhik American dollar kharide ja sakte hain. Bite 90 dino mein ek American dollar ke badle Bharatiya rupye ki adhiktam keemat 72.08 rupye tak pahunchi hai. Jabki Bangladeshi taka ki value adhiktam 84.77 tak ja chuki hai. Wahin bite dus varshon ki agar baat karein, toh ek American dollar ke saamne Bharatiya rupye ki nyuntam keemat 43.92 rupye tak rahi, jabki Bangladeshi taka ki keemat 68.24 taka rahi. Matlab bite dus varshon mein American dollar ke saamne Bharatiya currency ki tulna mein Bangladeshi currency ki sthiti tulnatmak roop se zyada behtar dar ke saath khadi hui hai. Bangladesh ki varshik GDP vriddhi dar Pakistan se dhai percent aage nikal chuki hai. title: कोयला घोटाला: क्या हो सकती हैं पीएम की मुश्किलें?
text: In vipakshi dalon ne Pradhan Mantri ki peshkash ko dikhawa bataya hai. In parties ne sabhi koyla blocks ke allotment ki jaanch ki maang ki hai. Koyla block allotment maamle mein sawalon se ghire Pradhan Mantri Manmohan Singh ka kehna hai ki unke paas chhupane ke liye kuch nahi hai. Russia aur China ki yatra se wapas lautne ke dauran Manmohan Singh ne apne vishesh vimaan mein patrakaron se kaha ki desh mein koi bhi vyakti kaanun se upar nahi hai. Unhone kaha, "Mere paas chhupane ko kuch bhi nahi hai. Main CBI aur kisi bhi anya jaanch ke liye tayar hoon." Istifa par sanshay udyogpati Kumar Mangalam Birla aur purv koyla sachiv PC Parakh ke khilaaf CBI ki or se darj karai gayi FIR ke baad se Manmohan Singh vipaksh ke nishane par aa gaye hain. Angrezi akhbar Hindustan Times ke rajneetik sampadak Pankaj Vohra ke mutabik Pradhan Mantri ki is peshkash ko CBI ko us samay gambhirta se lena hoga, jab Supreme Court ke aadesh use milenge kyunki is maamle ki jaanch Supreme Court ki nigraani mein ho rahi hai. Pankaj Vohra kehte hain iske siyasi parinaam ho sakte hain, "Agar Supreme Court CBI se kehti hai ki Pradhan Mantri ki bhi jaanch karo to Pradhan Mantri ka apne pad par bane rehna mushkil ho jayega." CBI karmachari vibhag ke tahat kaam karti hai jiska bagdore Pradhan Mantri ke haath mein hai. Vohra kehte hain, "Pradhan Mantri khud abhiukt aur jaanchakarta ek saath nahi ho sakte. Is surat mein Congress ke liye badi mushkil khadi ho jayegi." Lekin ab tak koi aise sanket nahi mile hain ki Pradhan Mantri apna pad chhodne wale hain. Pankaj Vohra kehte hain, "Manmohan Singh itni aasani se istifa dene wale nahi hain, haan agar Supreme Court ne aadesh diya ki unki jaanch honi chahiye to fir maamla bilkul alag hoga." Supreme Court ki nigraani Mangalwar ko Supreme Court mein is maamle mein status report saunpne ke baad CBI ne Pradhan Mantri Karyalay (PMO) se Birla ki company Hindalco ko coal block allot karne sambandhi dastavej uplabdh karane ko kaha tha. Supreme Court ne is maamle ki agle sunwai 29 October tay ki hai. CBI ke is rukh se Pradhan Mantri Manmohan Singh naye sire se vipaksh ke nishane par aa gaye hain. Pradhan Mantri Karyalay ne Aditya Birla group ki company Hindalco ko koyla block dene ke faisle ka bachav kiya hai. PMO ne kuch hi din pehle Hindalco ko koyla block ke allotment ko sahi thahrate hue kaha tha ki Pradhan Mantri Manmohan Singh ne unke samaksh pesh kiye gaye maamle ke gun-dosh ke aadhar par koyla block ke allotment ko manzoori di thi. CBI ne 15 October ko 2005 mein Odisha mein coal block allotment ke maamle mein Aditya Birla group ke pramukh Kumar Mangalam Birla aur purv koyla sachiv PC Parakh ke khilaaf FIR darj ki thi. title: प्रेस: अमरीका जाना है तो... सोशल मीडिया की भी जांच होगी
text: Akhbar ke anusar Trump administration ne naya form jari kiya hai jiske tahat visa karyalaya aavedankarta ko sabhi pichle passporton ke number, bite paanch saal ke social media account ki jaankari, email aur phone numbers ki jaankari deni hogi. Aavedakon ko apne rozgaar, yatraon aur bite 15 saalon ke apne jeevan ke baare mein bhi jaankari deni hogi. Naye form ke anusar in sawaalon ke uttar dena filhal zaroori nahi hoga lekin inke jawab na dene ki surat mein visa milne mein deri ho sakti hai ya visa nahi milne ki bhi sambhavna hai. Akhbar ke anusar in naye form ko May 23 ko manzoori mil gayi thi. American visa par Trump ka naya farman: 5 khaas baatein H1B visa karyakram mein sudhaar par sujhav Bharat ke sena pramukh General Bipin Rawat ne Srinagar mein sena ke sabhi commanders ke saath samiksha baithak ki hai. The Hindu ki report ke mutabik pehle se tay is baithak ko haal ke dino mein seema par Bharat aur Pakistan ke beech badh rahi jhadpon ke madde nazar aham mana ja raha hai. Report ke mutabik seema par Pakistan ki firing mein ek Bharatiya kaamgaar ki maut bhi hui hai. Bharat ne bhi jawabee firing ki hai jiska Pakistan ne Islamabad mein Bharatiya dutaavaas mein virodh darj karwaya hai. #UnseenKashmir: Kashmir ki kahani, CRPF ki zabaani #UnseenKashmir: Kashmiri bachon ki yeh chitrakari vichlit kar degi Indian Express akhbar ne das saal ke ek Kashmiri bachche ki aapbeeti prakaashit ki hai. title: मुश्किलों में घिरे नए जेम्स बॉन्ड
text: Bond fans ne ek website craignotbond.com ke zariye logon se ye aahvan kiya hai ki wo Sony aur Eon Productions ko James Bond ka bhavishya barbaad karne se roken. Website par Pierce Brosnan ke badle Daniel Craig ko naye James Bond banaye jaane par nirmata Barbara Broccoli aur Michael Wilson ki alochana ki gayi hai aur Pierce Brosnan ko Sean Connery ke baad ab tak ka sabse pasandida abhineta bataya gaya hai. Film nirmata Barbara Broccoli aur Michael Wilson behan-bhai hain. Lekin purv Bond abhineta Pierce Brosnan ne Daniel Craig ka paksh liya hai. Unka maanna hai ki Daniel Craig ek behtareen abhineta hain. Unhone kaha, "Rasta patharila aur mushkil zaroor hai lekin mera maanna hai ki aakhir mein jeet unhi ki hogi". Ek British comedy film 'The Matador' ke premiere ke avsar par unhone kaha ki unki sahanubhuti Craig ke saath hai. Craig haal hi mein nayi Bond film Casino Royale ki shooting mein ghaayal ho gaye the. Nayi film Casino Royale ke liye chune gaye British abhineta Daniel Craig, James Bond ki films ki shreni mein chhatthe Bond honge. Isse pehle is bhumika mein Pierce Brosnan parde par nazar aate the. James Bond ki bhumika mein 1962 se 1971 tak Sean Connery, 1969 mein George Lazenby, 1973 se 1985 tak Roger Moore, 1987 se 89 tak Timothy Dalton aur 1995 se 2002 tak Pierce Brosnan jaise kalakar darshakon ka manoranjan kar chuke hain.

title: आसाराम के बाद अब नारायण साईं का क्या होगा?
text: Asaram ke alawa Shiva, Sharatchandra, Shilpi aur Prakash is maamle mein abhiukt the. Adalat ne Shilpi aur Sharatchandra ko 20-20 saal ki saza sunai. Asaram ke ashram ke rasoiya Prakash aur Asaram ke niji sachiv rahe Shiva ko bari kar diya gaya. Sharatchandra Chhindwara ashram ke director the jahan naabalig ladki padhai karti thi. Shilpi Chhindwara ashram ki warden thi. Is beech, Asaram ke bete Narayan Sai ka kya haal hai. Jab Jodhpur ki adalat Asaram ki kismat ka faisla kar rahi thi, Surat ki sthalai adalat unke bete Narayan Sai ke khilaf balatkar ke maamle mein sunwai kar rahi thi. Gawahoon ke bayan darj kiye ja rahe hain jiske baad antim jirah hogi. Narayan Sai ko is maamle mein Guruvaar ko ek baar phir adalat mein pesh kiya gaya. 50 din tak farar the Narayan Sai. Sai ko Dilli police ne December, 2013 ko giraftar kiya tha. Wo 50 din tak farar rehne ke baad giraftar mein aaye the. Is maamle mein kul 34 logon par aarop hain jinmein Sai bhi shamil hain. Surat police ne is maamle mein do shikayat darj ki thi. Ek Asaram aur doosri Sai ke khilaf. 6 October, 2013 ko darj shikayat mein in dono par balatkar, yaun shoshan, bandhak banane ke aarop lage. Jahangirpura police thane mein do alag-alag aparaadhik shikayat darj hain. Baad mein Asaram ke khilaf maamla Ahmedabad bhej diya gaya tha. Dono behnon mein se chhoti ne Sai ke khilaf shikayat darj karai. Uska kehna hai ki saal 2002 se 2005 ke beech Surat mein Narayan Sai ne uska yaun shoshan kiya. Badi behan ne doosri shikayat mein Asaram ke khilaf shikayat ki thi aur aarop lagaya ki saal 1997 se 2006 ke beech uska yaun shoshan kiya gaya jab wo Ahmedabad ke baahar ek ashram mein reh rahi thi. Maa ke ilaaj ke liye zamaanat Gujarat uch nyayalay ne April 2015 mein Narayan Sai ko apni bimaar maa se milne ke liye teen hafte ki zamaanat di thi. Unki maa ko Ahmedabad mein ek private hospital mein bharti karaya gaya tha. Halankeh 29 April ko unhone adalat ne unki doosri zamaanat yachika kharij kar di thi jisne unhone apni maa ke dil ke operation ke liye zamaanat maangi thi. Adalat ne kaha ki unhe zamaanat tabhi milegi, jab doctor yeh bata denge ki unki maa ka operation kis tareekh ko hoga. Chunav ladne ke liye bhi maangi zamaanat Narayan Sai ne January 2017 mein Uttar Pradesh ke vidhan sabha chunavon mein apni ummidvaar ke liye court mein arzi dekar zamaanat ki appeal ki thi. Yachika mein unhone zikr kiya tha wo Uttar Pradesh ki do vidhan sabha seats se chunav ladna chahte hain. Chunavi tayyariyon ki dekhrekh ke liye unhe kuch dino ke liye jail se riha kiya jaye. Halankeh court ne unki zamaanat yachika kharij kar di thi. Narayan Sai ne Ojasvi Party naam se apna rajneetik sangathan bhi banaya hai. Dhamki aur hamle Asaram ke bete Narayan Sai aur unke samarthakon par case se jude gawahon aur police adhikaarion tak ko dhamki dene ke aarop lage hain. Un par gawahon ki hatya ka bhi aarop hai. title: बुश ने इराक़ी नेताओं की सराहना की
text: Halaanki abhi bhi naye sanvidhan ke masoude par sahmati nahi ho payi hai aur sansad mein manzoori ke liye ise pesh kiye jaane ki samay seema bhi ek saptah ke liye badha di gayi hai. Iske bawajood Amreeki rashtrapati Bush ne Iraaki netaon ki koshishon ko 'bahaduri' bataya. Amreeki videsh mantri Condoleezza Rice ne kaha ki Iraakiyon ne naye sanvidhan par sahmati ke liye achhi pragati ki hai. Rice ne kaha ki sabhi muddon par pragati hui hai. BBC samvadadata Jonathan Beale ka kehna hai ki pehle Amreeka hi 15 August ki samay seema ke andar sanvidhan par sahmati ke liye zor daal raha tha. Nazarandaaz lekin ab wahi sahmati na banne ki nakami ko nazarandaaz karne ki koshish kar raha hai. Amreeki videsh mantri Rice ne kaha ki yahi loktantra hai. Unhone kaha ki naye Iraak ke gathan ke liye Iraak ke log apni pratibaddhata prakat kar rahe hain. Rice ne kaha ki naye sanvidhan ke masoude par sahmati ke liye aur samay maangna yahi darshata hai ki ve aisa sanvidhan chahte hain jise vyapak samarthan mile. Rice ne kaha, "Mera maana hai ki ve ise poora kar lenge. Maine Iraaki logon ki pratikriya suni hai aur unka maana hai ki ve ise jald hi poora kar lenge. Main nahi maanti ki isse aage hume kuch atkal lagane ki avashyakta hai." Rice ne kaha ki yeh aisi prakriya hai jisme Iraakiyon ki hi bhagidari hai. Unhone kaha ki alpsankhyak Sunniyon ko bhi is prakriya mein shamil karne ki koshish ki gayi aur saath mein mahilaon ke adhikaron ko bhi dhyan mein rakha gaya hai.

title: हनीफ़ की पत्नी ने प्रधानमंत्री से अपील की
text: Dusri or Australian police ne Bharatiya mool ke doctor Haneef ke khilaf aarop tay karte hue kaha hai ki unhone London aur Glasgow mein viphal bomb hamlon ke liye 'aatankwadi sangathan ko sahyog' diya. Yadi yeh aarop sabit ho jata hai to doctor Haneef ko 15 saal tak ki saza ho sakti hai. Firdaus ne kaha ki uske doctor pati ke saath Australian adhikari anyaay nahi kar sakte aur wo laaparwahi ki wajah se abhiyukt ban gaye hain. Australian adhikaron ne aarop patra mein kaha hai ki doctor Haneef ne apne chachere bhaiyon Sabeel aur Kafeel Ahmed ko mobile phone ke SIM card uplabdh karvaye aur ek ‘aatankwadi sangathan’ ka sahyog kiya. Patrakaron se baat karte hue Firdaus ne kaha, "Ab tak main sanyam banaye thi kyunki soch rahi thi ki bina wajah unke (Haneef) khilaf koi aarop nahi lagaye jayenge. Lekin mujhe nahi pata tha ki Australian police aise kadam uthaegi." Firdaus ne kaha, "Main Pradhan Mantri aur Raksha Mantri se madad ki appeal karti hoon kyunki sabhi jaante hain ki wo nirdosh hain." Hirasat gaurtalab hai ki Bharatiya mool ke doctor Haneef ko us waqt hirasat mein le liya gaya tha jab wo Australia se Bharat aane ki koshish kar rahe the. 27 varshiya doctor Haneef pichle September mein Australia aaye the aur yahan Queensland ke Gold Coast hospital mein karya rat the. Isse pehle unhone London ke National Health Service ke liye kaam kiya tha. London aur Glasgow mein viphal hamlon ki saazish rachne ke aarop mein kul aath sandigdh logon ki giraftari hui thi. Inmein se saat sandigdh Britain mein giraftaar hue jabki Mohammad Haneef ko Australia mein giraftaar kiya gaya tha.

title: बहरीन में 16 भारतीयों की मौत
text: Is haadse mein kai logon ke ghayal hone ki bhi khabar hai. Maare gaye sabhi Bharatiya mazdoor hain. Bahrain police is maamle ki jaanch karegi aur jo bhi kadam uthaye jayenge uske baare mein suchit kiya jayega. Is haadse mein maare gaye logon ki pehchaan kar unke parivaarwaalon se sampark kiya jayega aur shavon ko Bharat laya jayega. Bahrain mein Bharat ke rajdoot Balakrishna Shetty ne BBC samvaddata Aakash Soni ke saath ek vishesh baatcheet mein kaha ki is maamle mein sambandhit company ki or se aniyamitata hui hai. Unhone bataya ki is company ko pehle bhi chetavani di gayi thi lekin company ne ise nazarandaaz kiya jis kaaran yeh haadsa hua. Balakrishna Shetty ne bataya ki is company mein kaam karne wale kai log gair kaanooni roop se yahan reh rahe hain. Unhone bataya ki is kaaran police aur ambulance pahunchne ke kaaran kai ghayal log wahan se nikal gaye.

title: INDvsAUS: 35 रनों से हारा भारत, ऑस्ट्रेलिया ने 3-2 से जीती सिरीज़
text: Paanch matches ki ODI series ke aakhri aur nirnayak muqabale mein Australia ne pehle batting karte hue Bharat ke saamne jeet ke liye 273 runs ka lakshya rakha tha lekin Bharatiya team 237 run par all out ho gayi. Australia ki jeet mein batsman Usman Khawaja, Peter Handscomb aur spinner Adam Zampa ne shandar pradarshan kiya. Khawaja ne shatak jada to Handscomb ne ardhashatak banaya. Wahi Zampa ne teen mahatvapurn wickets liye. Bharatiya batting ke dauran chauthe match mein apne ODI career ki sarvashreshth pari khelne wale Shikhar Dhawan sirf 12 run bana sake. 25ve over mein 120 run tak Bharat ne captain Kohli (20), wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant (16) aur Vijay Shankar (16) ke wickets gava diye. Is dauran Rohit Sharma ek chhor se pitch par date rahe aur apna 41va ardhashatak lagaya. Aakramak cricket khelne ke liye mashhoor Rohit is pari mein bahut sambhal kar khelte dikhai diye aur is dauran unhone ODI cricket mein 8,000 run poore kiye. Ardhashatak banane ke liye unhone 73 gendon ka saamna kiya. Iske baad wo ise badi pari mein nahi badal sake aur 89 gendon par 56 run bana kar out ho gaye. Rohit ke baad aaye Ravindra Jadeja apna khata bhi nahi khol sake aur Zampa ka shikar ban gaye. 132 run par chhe wickets gava chuki Bharatiya team ki jeet ki aas lagbhag samaapt ho chuki thi ki ek chhor se Kedar Jadhav aur doosri or se Bhuvneshwar Kumar jam gaye aur lagataar behatarin shots lagate rahe. Dono agle 17 overs tak pitch par tike rahe aur 91 runs ki ardhashataki saajhedari nibhayi. Lekin 46ve over ki aakhri gend par Bhuvneshwar (46) aur iske agle hi over ki pehli gend par Kedar Jadhav (44) ke out hone ke saath hi Bharat ki jeet ki umeed khatam ho gayi. Australia ki majboot shuruaat isse pehle Australia ne 50 overs mein 9 wickets par 272 run banaye. Shuruaati 30 overs mein mahaj ek wicket ke nuksan ke saath 161 run banakar Australia bade score ki taraf badh raha tha. Lekin Bharatiya gendbaazon ne ek baar phir beech ke overs mein wapas aate hue Australia ko bada score karne se rok diya. Australian batsmen ne agle dus overs mein mahaj 41 run jode jabki is dauran unke teen wickets gire. Phir aakhri 10 overs mein paanch wickets gava kar 70 run banaye. Ismein bhi 48ve over mein aaye 19 runs ke dam par Australian pari 255 se upar ja sakti. Ek samay lag raha tha ki Australian team aasani se 300 run bana legi lekin Bharatiya gendbaazon ne aakhri 20 overs mein unke aath wickets chhatka diye. Is dauran sirf 111 run bane aur Australia ka score 275 bhi nahi pahunch saka. Khawaja-Hanscomb ki jodi ne dusre wicket ke liye 111 gendon par 99 run ki ahem saajhedari nibhayi Khawaja-Hanscomb ki ahem saajhedari toss jeetkar pehle khelne utare Australia ke salami batsman captain Aaron Finch aur Usman Khawaja ne majboot shuruaat di. Dono ne pehle wicket ke liye 14.3 overs mein 76 runs ki saajhedari ki. Tez gendbaazon ke wicket lene mein asafal hone par Kohli ne spinners lagaye aur Ravindra Jadeja ne pehla wicket Finch ke roop mein le liya. Finch ne 43 gendon par 27 runs ki pari kheli. Iske baad Khawaja aur Peter Handscomb ne Bharatiya spinners ke saamne sambhal kar batting karte hue rah rah kar bade shots khelte rahe. Handscomb ne spinners par sweep shot ka istemal kiya to wahi Khawaja ne kadmon ka achha istemal karte hue run banaye. Khawaja ne 32ve over mein apne career aur is series ka doosra ODI shatak poora kiya. Handscomb ne 60 gendon par 52 runs ki achhi pari kheli. Pant ne chhoda catch Handscomb ke ardhashatak mein wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant ka bhi yogdan raha. Pant ne 32ve over mein Kuldeep ki doosri gend par Handscomb ka catch chhod diya tha. Halanki dono ki jodi 111 gendon par 99 run banane ke baad tab tooti jab Bhuvneshwar Kumar ki gend par Khawaja ne short covers par Kohli ko aasaan catch thama diya. 175 runs par doosra wicket girne ke baad pitch par aaye Glenn Maxwell lekin wo mahaj ek run bana kar Jadeja ka shikar bane. Doosri taraf ardhashatak poora karne ke baad Handscomb, Shami ka shikar ho gaye. Handscomb ka wicket 182 ke kul score par gira. Yahan se Bharatiya gendbaaz haavi ho gaye aur Australia ki run gati ko dheema kar diya. Stoinis aur Turner ne 20-20, Richardson ne 29 aur Cummins ne 15 run banaye. Australian pari mein Bhuvneshwar Kumar ne teen wickets liye jabki Mohammad Shami aur Ravindra Jadeja ne do-do aur Kuldeep Yadav ne ek wicket liya.
