title: रेल सेवा अजमेर तक बढ़ाने का प्रस्ताव
text: Saath hi Bharat ne Munabav-Khokharapar rail seva ko Ajmer tak badhane ka prastaav rakha hai taaki Pakistan se aane wale shraddhaluon ko Ajmer Sharif tak aane mein takleef na ho. Munabav aur Khokharapar ke beech 1 February se rail seva shuru hone wali hai. Bharat ka sujhav tha ki niyantran rekha ke aaspaas suraksha chokiyan sthapit na ki jayein aur niyantran rekha par brigade commander star ki flag meeting ho. Mangalvaar se Nai Dilli mein shuru hui videsh sachiv star ki baatcheet mein pehle din shanti aur suraksha par charcha hui. Budhwaar ko Kashmir par charcha hogi. Balochistan ka masla do dinon tak chalne wali is baatcheet mein Bharatiya pratinidhi mandal ka netritva videsh sachiv Shyam Saran aur Pakistani pratinidhi mandal ka netritva Riyaz Mohammad Khan kar rahe hain. Bharat ke videsh mantralay ke prabhakta Navtej Sarna ne bataya ki Pakistan ne parmanu masle par aapsi samajh badhane ke liye kuch naye sujhav pesh kiye hain. Lekin prabhakta ne inki jankari dene se inkaar kiya aur kaha ki abhi in par charcha honi hai. Pakistan ne Balochistan par Bharat ke bayan ka masla uthaya aur ise andaruni hastakshep maana. Bharat ne ise bebuniyaad bataya aur kaha ki Bharat ka hastakshep ka koi iraada nahi tha, usne keval pados ki ghatnaon par chinta jahir ki thi. Bharat ne doosri taraf charmpanth ki badhti ghatnaon par chinta jahir ki. Is baatcheet ke dauran ab tak bharosa badhane ki disha mein uthaye gaye kadmon ki samiksha bhi ki gayi aur dono pakshon ne ise santoshjanak paaya. Ismein rail seva, bus seva aur paanch sthal par niyantran rekha khole jaane par charcha hui. Mumbai aur Karachi mein vanijya dootaavas kholne mein aa rahi kathinaiyon par bhi baatcheet hui. Videsh sachiv star ki baatcheet Budhwaar ko bhi jaari rahegi aur ismein nashili davaon ki taskari, Siachen aur Kashmir par charcha hone ki ummeed hai.

title: अंतरधार्मिक शादी का हर मामला लव जिहाद नहीं: कोर्ट
text: Saath hi court ne kaha hai ki aisi shaadiyan deshhit mein hoti hain. V. Chidambaresan aur Satish Ninan ki nyayik khandpeeth ne apne faisle mein kaha ki sabhi antardharamika vivaah love jihad ki shreni mein nahi aate. Ek vakil ne is faisle ko waqt ki maang batate hue kaha, "In maamlon ko Kerala High Court ki hi alag-alag bench mein alag-alag tarah se niptaaya gaya hai." Pichle saal adalat ki kam se kam teen benches ke saamne love jihad ka maamla utha tha, jismein se ek maamle mein Supreme Court ne poocha tha ki adalat kis tarah do vayask logon ki shaadi khatam kar sakti hai. ...Phir to har shaadi love jihad hai. Adalat mein fansa ek Hindu-Muslim vivaah Shruti aur Anees ki prem kahani Chennai mein vakalat karne wali Geeta Ramasheshan ne BBC Hindi ko bataya, "Court ka yeh nirnay behad ahem hai, isse vayask apni pasand se shaadi karne ke adhikar ka upyog kar sakenge." Jis maamle mein court ki bench ne yeh faisla sunaaya, woh Shruti Meledath aur Anees Hameed se juda hai. Shruti aur Anees ek dusre se pyaar karte hain. Jab Shruti ne Anees ke saath shaadi karne ki baat apne ghar mein batayi to unke pita ne Anees ke mazhab ki wajah se inkaar kar diya. May 2017 mein Shruti aur Anees Kerala se bhaagkar Haryana ke Sonipat pahunch gaye. Unki gumshudgi ki report ke aadhar par Kerala police ne unhe giraftar kar court mein pesh kiya. 'Achhe din ki gajar agle chunav baad milegi' ‘Balig beti par pita ka niyantran nahi’ 'Yog kendra mein Shruti ko di gayi yaatanayein' Shruti ke parijanon ne unhe Ernakulam ke Udayamperoor sthit ek yog kendra mein bharti karwa diya, taaki woh dobaara dharmparivartan kar Hindu ban sake. Lekin Shruti ne apna dharm parivartan karvaya hi nahi tha. Shruti ne court mein bataya ki yog kendra mein use yaatanayein di jaati thi. Wahan uske jaise kam se kam 40 log aur the. Court ko diye apne bayan mein Shruti ne kaha, "Yog kendra ke adhikariyon ki baat na maanne par thappad aur pet par laat maari jaati thi. Jab maine Anees ke saath jaane ki ichha vyakt ki to mere munh par kapda thoonk kar mujhe chup karvaya gaya." 'Band hon dharm badlawane wale kendra' Anees ke vakil, R. Surendran ne bataya, "Zabardasti Shruti ka pregnancy test bhi karvaya gaya, agar woh positive nikalta to shayad woh uska abortion karva dete." Court ke aadesh ke baad police ne maamla darj kar yog kendra mein chhapa maara aur wahan ke adhikariyon ko hirasat mein liya. Iske saath hi yeh baat bhi saamne aayi ki Kerala mein dharmparivartan aur punah dharmparivartan kendra chal rahe hain aur is kaam mein kai kattar sangathan shamil hain. Court ne Kerala police ko yeh aadesh bhi diya ki "rajya mein zabardasti dharm parivartan aur punah dharmparivartan karvane wale kendron ko band kiya jaye, chahe woh kisi bhi dharm se jude kyun na hon. Samvidhan desh ke sab nagrikon ko apni ichha se dharm ka chayan karne ka adhikar deta hai." Court ki bench ne kaha, "Har antardharamika vivaah ko zabardasti dharmik rang dena uchit nahi hai. Yeh maamla poori tarah se prem se juda hua tha. Yahan jihad jaisa kuch bhi nahi tha." Yahan tak ki is maamle mein Shruti aur Anees apne-apne dharm ke saath hi rehna chahte the. Hapur mein unmaadi bheed se kaise bacha Hindu-Muslim joda? Kya Kashmir ke Ladakh mein ho raha hai 'love jihad'? Court ne kavita ke saath padha aadesh. Adalat ne Supreme Court ke us vaktavya ko bhi dohraaya jismein unhone Lata Singh aur Uttar Pradesh sarkar maamle mein antarsamuday vivaah ko deshhit mein bataya tha. Sarkari vakil Suman Chakraborty ne kaha, "Nyayik khandpeeth ka yeh faisla is waqt ki maang hai, kripya har shaadi ko bewajah ki sansani na banayein." Court ne apne aadesh ki shuruaat Amreeki kavi Maya Angelou ki kavita ki panktiyon se ki, jo is tarah hain, "Prem kisi prakaar ki bandishon ko nahi maanta, woh sabhi mushkilon ko faand kar, bandishon se chhalang laga kar, deewaron ko todkar, umeedon ki apni manzil tak zaroor pahunchta hai." title: पोस्टपार्टम डिप्रेशन जिसके बारे में लोग कम जानते हैं
text: "Kya aap cheezon ka mazakia hissa dekh paati hain? Kuch galat hone par khud ko bewajah zimmedar thahrati hain?" Toh thodi der ke liye aap zaroor hairaan ho jaayengi. Khaas taur par tab, jab aap pehli baar maa banne ja rahi ho. Ek toh pehli baar maa banne par hone wale saare ehsaas naye hote hain, us par is tarah ke sawaal aapke mann mein kai aashankayein bhi paida karte hain. Australia mein rehne wali Kadambari ke saath bhi kuch aisa hi hua. Kadambari doosri baar maa banne ja rahi thi. Is baar wo Australia mein reh rahi thi. Unki pehli beti Bharat mein paida hui thi. "Haan, main maa nahi banna chahti... toh? Ek ladki, jo achanak maa ban gayi." Kadambari aur unka parivaar jab Australia mein doctor se milne gaye, toh unse doctor ne aise hi paanch-saat sawaal ek saath pooche - "Kya aap aksar dukhi rahati hain aur rone ki ichha hoti hai?" "Kya aapko khud ko nuksan pahunchane ka khayal aata hai?" Sawaal sun kar Kadambari ko zara bhi ehsaas nahi hua ki jo sawaal unse pooche gaye hain wo kisi bimari se jude hain. Pehli baar toh unhone bina jaane aur bina koi sawaal pooche sabhi jawab de diye. Lekin, doosri baar jab usi se milte-julte sawaal pooche gaye toh wo khud ko rok nahi paayi. Unhone pooch hi liya, "Aakhir in sawaalon ka meri pregnancy se kya lena dena hai." Kadambari ka ye sawaal kuch had tak sahi bhi tha. Jab wo pehli baar maa bani thi toh wo Bharat mein thi. Us waqt doctor ne kabhi unse aisa koi sawaal nahi poocha tha. #HerChoice: Main lesbian hoon aur meri maa ye jaanti hain. #HerChoice: 'Maine shaadi nahi ki, isliye tumhare pita nahi hain.' Kadambari ki betiyan Kadambari ko jawab mila, "Ye sabhi sawaal isliye hain taaki hum pata laga paayen ki kahin aap postpartum depression se toh nahi joojh rahi hain." Tab pehli baar Kadambari ko postpartum depression ke baare mein pata chala. Doctor ne unhe bataya ki prasav ke baad mahilaon ke vyavhaar mein udasi, tanav, chidhchidhahat aur gusse jaise badlav aate hain. Aise mein unhe parivaarik sahyog aur ilaj ki zarurat hoti hai. Kadambari batati hain, "Yeh mere liye pehla aur bahut sukhad anubhav tha. Ab tak sirf sharirik pareshaniyon par baat hoti thi, lekin ab koi meri maansik sthiti par bhi baat kar raha tha, jise aam taur par samajh paana bahut mushkil hota hai." "Jab doctor ne mujhe postpartum depression ke baare mein bataya toh mujhe ahsaas hua ki pehle prasav ke baad bhi maine apne vyavhaar mein aise hi badlav mehsoos kiye the. Tab maine jis aspatal mein ilaj karaya tha, wahan ke doctor ne mujhe aise kisi bhi badlav ke baare mein nahi samjhaya. Mujhe parivaar se bahut sahyog mila, isliye ye pareshaniyan apne aap khatam ho gayi." Kitna mushkil hai ek pradhan mantri ke liye maa banna kya hota hai postpartum depression? Kadambari kehti hain, "Jab pehla bachcha hua toh mujhe nahi pata tha ki bachche ki dekhbhal kaise karni hoti hai. Mujhe apne sharir ko lekar bhi thodi chinta thi. Is karan main thodi chidhchidhii ho gayi thi. Main apne aap ko sambhal nahi paati thi aur bahut gussa aata tha. Yahan tak ki office mein raho toh ghar ki chinta aur ghar par raho toh office ka tanav rehta tha." Manoshikitsak Dr. Praveen Tripathi kehte hain ye samasya kareeb 20 se 70 pratishat mahilaon mein hoti hai. Shuruaati star par ise postpartum blues kehte hain. Iske lakshan bahut samanya hote hain. Jaise mood swing, udasi, chidhchidhahat, rone ki ichha hona aur bachche ko sambhal paungi ya nahi iski chinta hona. Vyavhaar mein aaya ye badlav kuch samay baad apne aap theek ho jaata hai. Iske liye dawaon ki zarurat nahi hoti. Lekin, agar lakshan badh jaayein toh ilaj zaroori ho jaata hai. Bimari badhne par neend nahi aati, bhukh nahi lagti, mareez apne aap mein gum rehta hai aur use aatmahatya ke khayal aate hain. Ye bimari ka agla star hai aur ise postpartum depression kehte hain. Ismein kai baar mahila apna bachcha sambhalna bhi chhod deti hai. Wo bachche ke liye khatarnaak bhi saabit ho jaati hai. Halankhi, aisa bahut kam maamlo mein hota hai. Dilli ke GB Pant aspatal mein strirog visheshagya Bhanupriya batati hain ki prasav ke baad hone wali maansik pareshaniyan kisi bhi tarah ki ho sakti hain. Jaise ki iska ek aur hissa hai postpartum anxiety. Ismein mahila apne bachche ke liye bahut dar jaati hai. Use har cheez mein khatra mehsoos hone lagta hai. Kai baar wo bachche ko kisi ko haath bhi nahi lagane deti. Kya hain postpartum depression ke kaaran? Dr. Praveen Tripathi kehte hain ki maa ke vyavhaar mein badlav ke kai kaaran ho sakte hain. Jinmein se kuch is prakar hain - postpartum depression ka ilaj kya hai? Agar lakshan shuruaati hain toh iske liye dawaon ki zarurat nahi hoti. Lekin bimari badh jaane par manoshikitsak ko dikhana zaroori hai. Dr. Praveen batate hain ki prasav ke baad mahilaon ko parivaar ke sahyog ki bahut zarurat hoti hai. Wo kai sharirik aur maansik badlavon se guzar rahi hoti hain. Aise mein un par achhi maa banne ka dabav na daalein aur bachche ki dekhbhal karne mein madad karein. Unhe bhavnaatmak sahyog dein aur dhairya rakhein. Iske alawa medication therapy di jaati hai aur dawaon ke saath-saath counseling se ilaj kiya jaata hai. Ismein ek aur baat maayne rakhti hai aur wo hai aspatal ki taraf se sahi jaankari diya jaana. Jaisa ki Kadambari ke maamle mein hua. Na sirf garbhadhan ke dauran unki manodasha par baat ki gayi balki prasav ke baad ghar par check-up ke liye aane wali nurse gharwalon ke vyavhaar ke baare mein poochti thi. Yahan tak ki Kadambari ke pati se bhi poocha gaya ki kya wo bhi kisi tanav ya pareshani se guzar rahe hain. Aise mein agar aspatal ki taraf se samay par aur sahi jaankari mile toh mareez ki kaafi madad ho sakti hai. Tantra-mantra ka sahara postpartum depression ke liye Bharat mein jagrukta ki bahut kami hai. Dr. Bhanupriya kehti hain, "Log mahila ke vyavhaar mein achanak aaye is badlav ko aksar doosre kaaron se jod dete hain. Koi ise sharirik kamzori maan leta hai toh koi bhoot-preet ka saya. Aise mein wo log jaanbhoojhkar doctor ke paas nahi aate balki tantra-mantra ka sahara lete hain." Is bimari ka sabse achha ilaj hai ki logon ko iske prati jagruk kiya jaaye. title: राजनाथ ख़ेमे को सता रहा है भीतरघात का डर?
text: Rajnath ke liye andar se jitna khatra hai utna hi bada khatra unko Congress ki Rita Bahuguna Joshi se hai. Bhale hi Mulayam Singh Yadav ne Ashok Vajpayee ko hata kar aur Abhishek Mishra ko ticket de kar unki mushkil kam karne ki poori koshish ki hai, lekin pradesh ke purv mukhyamantri rahe Rajnath ki dagar filhal kathin hai. Ghaziabad chhod Lucknow se Atal Bihari Vajpayee ki rajneetik virasat ki zimmedari Rajnath Singh ne apne upar lene ki thaani aur apne ko Atalji ka uttaradhikari maanne wale Lalji Tandon ke par katar diye gaye. Saal 2009 mein Lucknow se MP rahe Tandon ko is baar ticket nahi mila. Tandon ki narazgi jis prakar media mein yeh baat aayi ki Lucknow se is baar Rajnath chunav ladenge aur Tandon ko iski khabar bhi nahi di gayi, usse Tandon aahat the. Rajnath se baat ke baad unki narazgi door to hui lekin us din se yeh charcha aam hai ki kahin na kahin aahat Tandon apne party adhyaksh ko chot na pahunchadein. Waise to Rajnath ne Lucknow mein apni press conference mein yeh kaha tha ki woh Tandon ke agrah se hi Lucknow se chunav lad rahe hain aur Tandon bhi chunav ki tayyariyon mein gambhirta se lage hain. Baatcheet mein bhi Tandon aur unke sahyogi yeh zahir nahi hone dete hain ki unmein aapsi manmutav hai. Lekin bite kuch varshon ki aur haal hi ki ghatnaon se nahi lagta ki dono paksh ek dusre par poora bharosa rakh kar kaam kar rahe hain. Is kadi ki pehli ghatna saal 2009 ki hai jab Vidhan Sabha upchunav ke liye Lucknow Paschim se Amit Puri ne Bharatiya Janata Party ki or se apna naamankan daakhil kiya tha. Bheetarghat ka dar Lucknow Atal Bihari Vajpayee ka chunavi kshetra raha hai. Amit Puri chunav haar gaye aur unhone Tandon ko doshi thahraya. Iske do kaaran the. Pehla yeh ki Lucknow Paschim Tandon ka garh hai. Aur doosra yeh ki Tandon apne bete Gopal ko ticket dilana chahte the. Saath hi yeh bhi kaha jata hai ki Puri ko ticket dilane mein Rajnath ka haath tha. Saal 2012 ke Vidhan Sabha chunav mein Gopal Tandon ko ticket mila lekin woh bhi chunav haar gaye. Is haar ka dosh diya gaya Rajnath ko. Apni haar ka kaaran samjhate hue Amit Puri kehte hain, "Saal 2009 ke upchunav mein main dal ka pratyashi bana, dil ka nahi." Yeh poochhne par ki woh kiske dil ke pratyashi nahi ban sake - janta ya party ke kuch netaon ke, to Puri bole, "BJP ke ek dhade ka." Aaj usi dhade ke Lalji Tandon aur unke bete Gopal dono hi Rajnath ki madad karte nazar aate hain kintoo Rajnath ke bete Pankaj Singh aur kuch anya Thakur bhi chunavi rananiti banane mein sakriya hain. Kuch anya jaati ke karyakartaon ko yeh nahi suha raha hai ki 'Thakur' unko aagya dein. Ek aur baat. Pichle maah Holi ke baad Lalji Tandon ne har varsh ki bhanti is varsh bhi ek kavi sammelan ka aayojan kiya. Lekin is saal ke aayojan mein fark yeh tha ki wahan Rita Bahuguna Joshi, Ashok Vajpayee aur Abhishek Mishra bhi maujood the. Bheetarghat Lucknow ke kuch samacharpatron ne Joshi se batiyate hue Tandon ki photo prakashit kar bheetarghat ki charcha ko majbooti dene ki koshish ki. Puri in baaton ko zyada mahatv nahi dete hain. Woh itna zaroor maante hain ki chunav mushkil hoga lekin jeet Rajnath ki hi hogi. Saazish ki baat par Puri kehte hain ki kuch log yeh kehte suna gaye hain ki Thakur aur Brahmin ko agar English mein likha jaye to unke pehle akshar ko jod kar TB banta hai jo ek jaanleva bimari hoti hai. Aisa isliye kaha ja raha hai kyunki Lucknow ke 18 lakh matdataon mein Brahminon ki sankhya 15-20 pratishat hai aur 60 hazaar se 65 hazaar Rajput hain jabki Muslim votaron ki sankhya 25-27 pratishat hai. Lucknow ke maujooda vidhayakon mein teen Brahmin hain aur Lok Sabha ke teen pratyashi Rita Bahuguna Joshi, Abhishek Mishra aur Nakul Dubey bhi Brahmin hain. text: Unhone BBC ko bataya, "Poora tarah viksit krtrima buddhimatta (AI) maanav jaati ki vinash katha likh sakti hai." Unhone yeh chetavani us sawaal ke jawab mein di jo unke baat karne ke liye istemal hone wali technique ko durust karne ko lekar tha, jismein shuruaati star ki AI shamil ho. Lekin anya log AI ki sambhavnayon ko lekar bahut ashankit nahi hain. 'Sakaratmak taakat' sidhantik bhautik vigyani Hawkins ko motor neuron bimari amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) hai aur woh bolne ke liye Intel ke viksit ek naye system ka istemal kar rahe hain. British company SwiftKey ke machine learning visheshagya bhi ise banane mein shamil rahe hain. Unki technique - jo ki pehle hi smartphone ke keyboard app mein istemal ho rahi hai - yeh seekhti hai ki professor kya sochte hain aur aisa shabd prastaavit karti hain jo woh sambhavta bolne wale hon. Professor Hawkins kehte hain ki ab tak viksit krtrima buddhimatta ke shuruaati prakaar behad upyogi saabit ho chuke hain lekin unhe dar hai ki iska asar aisi cheez banane mein pad sakta hai jo insaan jitni ya usse zyada buddhimaan ho. Woh kehte hain, "Yeh apna niyantran apne haath mein le lega aur phir khud ko fir se tayyar karega jo hamesha badhta hi jaayega." "Chunki jaivik roop se insaan ka vikas dheere hota hai, woh pratiyogita nahi kar paayega aur pichhad jaayega." Cleverbot ke nirmaata, Rollo Carpenter kehte hain, "Mujhe lagta hai ki hum acche-khaase samay tak technique ke niyantrak bane rahenge aur duniya ki samasyaon ko suljhane mein iski kshamataon ka ahsaas ho jaayega." Cleverbot ka software apni pichhli baatcheet se seekhta hai aur Turing test mein kaafi unche score haasil kar chuka hai. Isse kai log yeh dhokha kha chuke hain ki woh kisi insaan se baat kar rahe hain. Carpenter kehte hain ki hum poori krtrima buddhimatta ko viksit karne ke liye computing kshamata haasil karne se bahut door hain. Halanki unhe yaqeen hai ki kuch dashkon mein yeh aa jaayegi. Woh kehte hain, "Hum darasal nahi jaante ki jab machine hamari buddhimatta se zyada haasil kar legi to kya hoga. Isliye hum nahi jaante ki yeh humein anant madad karegi, ya dar kinaar kar degi ya jaisa ki maana jaata hai, nasht kar degi." Halanki woh daawa karte hain ki krtrima buddhimatta ek sakaratmak taakat hogi. 'Bachchon ki pasand' lekin Professor Hawkins akele nahi hain jo bhavishya ke prati ashankit hain. Haal filhal mein yeh chinta badhi hai ki aise kaam jo ab tak insaan hi karte the unhe karne ke kaabil chatur machines chupke se laakhon naukriyaan kha rahi hain. Technique udyami Elon Musk chetavani dete hain ki deerghkaal mein krtrima buddhimatta hi 'hamara sabse bada maujooda khatra' hai. BBC ko diye gaye sakshatkar mein Professor Hawkins ne internet ke faydon aur khatron ke baare mein bhi baat ki. Unhone GCHQ ke nideshak ko udghrit kiya ki internet aatankvadiyon ka command center ban raha hai, "Is khatre se bachne ke liye internet companies ko aur kaam karna hoga, lekin mushkil yeh hai ki aisa azaadi aur nijta ko bachate hue karna hoga." Halanki woh sabhi tarah ki sanchar technique ko utsukta se grahan karte rahe hain aur unhe ummeed hai ki naye system se woh zyada tezi se likh sakenge. Lekin ek takneeki paksh - unki computerized awaaz, taza update mein bhi nahi badli hai. Professor Hawkins maante hain ki yeh thodi robotic lagti hai, lekin zor dekar kehte hain ki woh zyada sahaj awaaz nahi chahte the. Unhone kaha, "Yeh mera trademark ban gaya hai aur main ise British lahze wali zyada sahaj awaaz ke saath nahi badalunga." "Mujhe bataya gaya ki jo bachche computer ki awaaz chahte hain, ve zyada tar meri tarah ki chahte hain." (BBC Hindi ke Android app ke liye yahan click karein. Aap hume Facebook aur Twitter par bhi follow kar sakte hain.)

title: पर्यटन को उद्योग बनाने का अधूरा सपना
text: Aashcharya nahi agar is tulna ke baad ve paate hain ki prakritik saundarya mein dono ki koi tulna nahi aur Himalaya ki chotiyaan laajawab hain. Lekin suvidhaon ki agar baat karein to Bharat se Switzerland jaana shayad Pithoragarh jaane se zyada aasan ho. Aur yahi wada tha pichhli sarkaron ka ki wo Uttarakhand mein paryatan ki suvidhaon ka vikas karengi, lekin poora nahi ho saka. Congress ke neta aur party ki taraf se prachar ki kamaan sambhale Kripashankar Singh is waade ke poora na hone ke sawaal par sweekar karte hain, "Ismein kya shak hai ki Uttarakhand jaisa rajya Bharat ya poori duniya mein nahi hai lekin paryatan ko vikasit karne mein kai vyavaharik dikatien aayi hain." Ve maante hain, "Paryatan ke kshetra mein jitna kaam hona chahiye tha, uska das pratishat kaam hi ho saka hai aur 90 pratishat hona bacha hai." Lekin Pithoragarh ke hotel vyavsaayi Alok Punetha kehte hain, "Darasal sarkaron ne paryatan ke liye ab tak kuch kiya hi nahi hai." Unka aarop hai ki paryatan vyavsay ya udyog abhi rajneetik dalon ke agenda mein hi nahi hai. Alok kehte hain, "Aisa nahi hai ki paryatan hai hi nahi. Lekin wo kuch hi jilon tak simit hai. Agar sach mein paryatan ko badhana hai to nai-nai jagahen vikasit karni hongi." Ve maante hain ki Pithoragarh ke Munsiyari ko agar vikasit kiya ja saka to agle chaar-paanch saalon mein yeh duniya ke bade paryatan sthal ke roop mein jaana jaayega. Rozgar Alok Punetha ki tarah Dainik Jagran akhbar ke bureau pramukh Dr. Deepak Upreti bhi maante hain ki paryatan ko vikasit karne ka matlab hai naye paryatan sthal ka vikas. Ve kehte hain, "Pichhle saat saalon mein sarkar ne kisi bhi naye paryatan sthal ko vikasit karne ki koshish nahi ki." Hotel vyavsaayi aur sthaniya log maante hain ki Almora se lekar Ranikhet aur Haridwar se lekar Badrinath-Kedarnath tak jo vikasit paryatan sthal hain wo is baat ka saboot hain ki isse paryapt sankhya mein logon ko rozgar mil sakta hai. Lekin ye sabhi paryatan sthal paryapt lokpriya hain aur wahan pahunchne wale paryatak ki sankhya paryapt hai. Dr. Upreti kehte hain, jab tak dhaanche ka vikas nahi hoga kuch nahi ho sakta. Udaharan dete hue ve batate hain ki Pithoragarh mein 12 saal pehle ek havai patti bani thi lekin uska vikas kabhi nahi kiya gaya. Zahir hai ki paryatan, jo berozgaari jhel rahe ek rajya mein rozgar muhayya karane ka ek bada saadhan ho sakta hai, chunavi ghoshna patraon mein koi bada mudda nahi hai. Albatta yeh naara zarur hai ki paryatan udyog ko vikasit kiya jaayega.

title: 'गैस पाइपलाइन पर तीनों देश सहमत'
text: Is mudde par charcha karne ke liye teenon deshon ke senior adhikari Pakistan ki capital Islamabad mein hain. Is dauran pariyojana ke financial, vaidhanik aur technical pakshon par baat ki jaayegi. Yojana ke anusar saat arab dollar ki lagat wali ye gas pipeline Iran se Pakistan hote hue India tak gas pahunchayegi. Umeed ki ja rahi hai ki June mein teenon desh is baare mein samjhaute par hastakshar karenge. Is pariyojana par America ke virodh ke chalte pichle kuch mahino mein khaas pragati nahi ho payi hai. Iran ke parmanu karyakram ko lekar America ko aapatti hai. America ka aarop hai ki Iran parmanu hathiyar banana chahta hai. Lekin Iran is aarop se inkaar karta aaya hai. America ne India aur Pakistan se kaha tha ki ve ek anya pipeline par kaam karein jo Turkmenistan aur Afghanistan se hote hue aaye. India ke liye Iran-Pakistan-India gas pipeline kaafi mahatvapurn hai kyunki is pariyojana ke poora hone par India urja ki kami ko poora kar payega. Pipeline ke silsile mein India ke purv tel mantri Mani Shankar Aiyar Pakistan ka daura kar chuke hain.

title: डोनाल्ड ट्रंप की वापसी की उम्मीदों पर पानी फेर देगा यह विवाद?
text: Trump ka yeh kathit bayan sabse pehle 'The Atlantic' patrika mein chhapa aur uske baad uske kuch ansh ko Associated Press aur Fox News ne prakaashit kiya tha. Halankeh Amreeki Rashtrapati Donald Trump aur unke sahyogiyon ne is bayan se inkaar kiya hai. Amreeki sena ke purv sainikon ne in reporton ke baad Donald Trump ki alochana ki hai. Pragatisheel group VoteVets ne ek video post kiya jismein ve parivaar dikh rahe hain jinke bachche yudh mein maare gaye hain. Ek ne likha hai, "Aapko nahi maaloom ki balidan kya hota hai?" Samapt Amreeki sena ki or Iraq aur Afghanistan mein tainaat rahe purv sainik Paul Rechov ne tweet kiya hai, "Isse vastav mein achraj kisko hua hai?" Vishleshak ka maanna hai ki isse Donald Trump ke dobaara rashtrapati chune jaane ki umeedon ko jhatka lag sakta hai kyunki unhe sainikon ke parivaar ke maton ki zaroorat hai. Trump ne aakhir kya kaha tha? 'The Atlantic' ke mutabik, Trump ne Paris mein 2018 mein Amreeki sainikon ke smarak sthal par jaane ka daura 'haare hue logon se bhari jagah' kehate hue radd kar diya tha. Is patrika ko chaar srotone ne bataya ki unhone wahan jaana isliye radd kiya tha kyunki baarish ho rahi thi aur isse unke baalon ke bigad jaane ka dar tha, saath hi yudh mein maare gaye Amreekiyon ka sammaan karna unke liye mahatvapurn nahi tha. Isi daure par, Amreeki rashtrapati ne kathit roop se Belleau Wood mein maare gaye 1800 Amreeki sainikon ko buddhu bataya tha. Is yudh ke chalte hi pehle vishwa yudh ke dauran German sena Paris tak nahi pahunch payi. In sainikon ko Amreeki Marine Corps ne sammaanit kiya hua hai. 'The Atlantic' ne apni reporting mein gopniya sroton ka havala diya hai lekin Associated Press ne kaha hai ki usne svatantra roop se in bayanon ki pushti ki hai. Wahi Fox News ki samvadadata ne kaha hai ki unhone kuch bayanon ki pushti ki hai. Is karyakram ko radd kiye jaane par 2018 mein Amreeki White House ne kaha tha ki kharab mausam ke chalte rashtrapati ka helicopter nahi ud paya tha. Is baat ki pushti Amreeki rashtrapati Donald Trump ke purv rashtriya suraksha salahkar John Bolton ne haal mein likhi kitab mein ki hai, halankeh wo Trump ke mukhar alochak hain. BuzzFeed ke reporter Jason Leopold ke soochna ki azaadi kanun ke tahat maangi gayi jankari ke jawab mein Amreeki nau sena ne bhi kaha ki Trump samadhi sthal par isliye na ja paane ki wajah baarish thi. Trump ke bayan ki alochana karne walon mein November mein rashtrapati pad ke liye unki daavedari ko chunauti dene ja rahe Joe Biden ne kaha ki Trump desh ka netritva karne mein unfit hain. Unhone kaha hai, "Agar yeh alekh sahi hai- anya baaton ke aadhar par aisa prateet bhi hota hai. Unhone jo kaha hai wo abhadra hai, apmaan jaisa hai." Amreeki sena mein rah chuki Democratic Senator Tammy Duckworth Iraq mein tainaati ke dauran apne dono pair gawa chuki hain. Unhone kaha, "Donald Trump apni ego ke liye Amreeki sena ka istemal karna pasand karte hain." Iraq mein maare gaye ek sainik ke pita Khizr Khan ne Tim Duckworth ki appeal ka samarthan kiya hai. Wo 2016 mein bhi Trump ki alochana kar chuke hain. Unhone kaha, "Jab doosron ki seva mein apni jaan ganvane walon ko Trump loser keh sakte hain to isse hum Trump ki aatma ko samajh rahe hain." Rashtrapati karyalay kaise nipat raha hai? Amreeki rashtrapati Donald Trump ne is khabar ko fake news bataya hai. Unhone kaha, "Hamari sena ke khilaf main negative bayan de sakta hoon, apne hero ke khilaf bayan de sakta hoon, aisa sochne se pehle yeh dekhein ki maine budget mein jo kiya hai wo kisi ne nahi kiya hai. Senya budget ko badhaya, senyakarmiyon ka vetan badhaya hai. Yeh ek patrika ki or se ghrit kadam hai aur yeh patrika ekdum bekaar patrika hai." Shukravar ko samvadaton se baat karte hue Trump ne kaha ki is story ke source White House ke purv Chief of Staff John Kelly ho sakte hain. Unhone yeh bhi kaha ki America ke purv Marine General is kaam ke dabav ko sambhalne mein saksham nahi hain. Amreeki videsh mantri Mike Pompeo ne Fox News se shukravar ki subah bataya ki wo rashtrapati ke saath is daure par the aur unhone kabhi aise shabd nahi sune. Wahi Amreeki raksha mantri Mark Esper ne Politico patrika se kaha hai ki Trump desh ke sainikon, unke parivaar ke sadasyon, purv sainikon aur unke parivaar ke prati kaafi sammaan rakhte hain. Halankeh unhone is khabar ka spasht roop se khandan nahi kiya hai. Iske alawa White House ke purv Chief of Staff Mick Mulvaney aur purv press secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders ne bhi is khabar ko galat bataya hai. Ye dono bhi Trump samarthak maane jaate hain. Trump aur Amreeki sena ka sambandh Amreeki rashtrapati Donald Trump aam taur par daava karte rahe hain ki unhe senya biradri ka majboot samarthan hasil hai. Pew Research Center ne beete saal ek survey mein paaya tha ki purv sainik Trump ko Commander in Chief maante hain aur kareeb 57 percent purv sainikon ka samarthan Trump ko hasil hai. Itna hi nahi har paanch purv sainikon mein teen Republican samarthak bataye gaye the. Halankeh sena ko lekar Donald Trump ke bayanon par vivaad pehle bhi hue hain. Vietnam yudh ke qaidi rahe aur baad mein senator bane John McCain par tippani karte hue Trump ne kaha tha, "Wo yudh ke hero nahi the. Main un logon ko pasand karta hoon jo qaidi nahi bane." Donald Trump kabhi Amreeka sena mein shamil nahi hue. Vietnam yudh ke dauran unhe paanch maukon par sena mein shamil nahi kiya gaya, chaar baar akademik wajahon se aur ek baar ediyon ki haddiyon mein takleef ke chalte. title: मेहनत और मोबाइल ने चमकाई इनकी क़िस्मत
text:
Kuch nahi se bahut kuch banne wale in udyogpatiyon ke beech sabse khaas baat ye thi ki inhone apne business idea mein sabse zyada tawajjo mobile phone ko diya. Aaiye jaante hain aise hi kuch udyogpatiyon ke baare mein jinki kismat chamkane mein mobile ka bada yogdaan raha.

Neeraj Roy, Hungama Digital  
Neeraj Roy dakshin Asia ke jaane maane mobile innovators mein se ek hain. Mobile entertainment aur value added services ke kshetra mein dakshin Asia ki sabse badi companies mein se ek ‘Hungama Digital’ ke sansthapak Neeraj Roy ne apne career ki shuruaat ek hotel samuh mein naukri ke saath shuru ki thi, lekin unke mann mein hamesha ye baat thi ki wo ek din udyogpati banenge aur wo bane bhi. Aaj unki company mobile ke liye audio-video aur text content se lekar films par aadharit games tak bana rahi hai. Mobile media kshetra mein bada naam kama chuke Neeraj Roy ne Hungama ki shuruaat saal 1999 mein ek website ke taur par ki thi. Ab unki company ke paas paanch lakh se zyada desi-videshi gaanon ke adhikaar hain. “Hungama company ko humne saal 1999 mein shuru kiya aur pehle kuch saal ise ek paramparik internet company ke taur par chalaya. Saal 2005 ke kareeb hum mobile kshetra mein ghuse aur ise dhyan mein rakhte hue kai prayog kiye jisse humein kaafi fayda pahuncha. Aaj hum mobile entertainment ke kshetra mein ek majboot roop se sthapit company ban chuke hain.”

Vijay Shekhar Sharma, One97 Communications  
Vijay Shekhar Sharma One97 Communications ke sansthapak aur prabandh nideshak hain. Vijay Shekhar Sharma tezi se vikasit ho rahi mobile internet companies mein se ek One97 Communications ke sansthapak aur prabandh nideshak hain. Anya Gupta ki kitaab ‘The Captainship’ mein saanjha kiye apne anubhavon mein Vijay Shekhar Sharma ne kaha hai ki wo ganit padhna chahte the, lekin unke pita ki ichha thi ki wo doctor bane. Baad mein unke ghar mein isi baat ne vaad-vivaad ki sthiti utpann ki. Captainship mein unhone kaha, “Meri yathasthiti ko sweekar na karne ki aadat ki shuruaat inhi vivaadon ke beech hui. Maine apne aaspaas maujood cheezon ko nakarna shuru kar diya aur khud ko un logon se alag kar diya jo paristhitiyon ko jaise ka taisa sweekar kar lete hain. Maine turant hi naukri karne ki sambhavna ke khayal ko dimaag se nikaal baahar phenka.” “Ek naukri bhala mujhe kya de sakti thi? Maine tay kiya ki main naukri nahi karunga. Main aisa aadmi banoonga jo doosron ko naukri deta ho. Us waqt main 17 saal ka tha.” Sharma ne apne college ke dost ke saath milkar apni internet company banayi aur achanak ek din unke paas New Jersey ki ek company se unki company ko kharidne ka prastaav aaya. One97 business ki shuruaati dino mein jyotishi company ke daftaar mein baithte the aur apna bhavishya jaanne ke ichhuk log 901 number dial karke unse baat kar sakte the. Isi tarah kai alag-alag projects ke zariye company aage badhi aur company ke anusaar haal hi mein hue mulyankan mein One97 ki keemat 30 crore dollar aankhi gayi.

Sanjeev Bikhchandani, India Info  
Sanjeev Bikhchandani naukri.com ke sansthapak hain. Internet par naukri ka bazaar lagane wale naukri.com ke sansthapak aur executive vice president Sanjeev Bikhchandani ko saal 2008 mein “Ernst and Young Entrepreneur” sanyukt award mila. Pehli pidhi ke udyogpati Sanjeev Bikhchandani ne InfoEdge company ki shuruaat 1990 mein ek garage se ki. Us waqt unki company job survey aur online database banane mein lagi thi. Ye us waqt unke liye ek badi uplabdhi thi. Baad mein naukri.com ek badi job portal ke roop mein ubhri aur aaj uske traffic ka ek bada hissa mobile se aata hai. Company ne haal hi mein apna naya Android app launch kiya hai aur reporton ke anusar pehle hi mahine mein kareeb teen lakh logon ne ise download bhi kiya hai. Is vishesh series mein mobile aur iske prayog se jude sawaalon aur anubhavon ko humse share karne ke liye aaiye hamare Facebook pann par ya tweet kijiye #BBCMI par. title: आरजेडी के साथ नहीं जाएँगेः पासवान
text: Chunav Aayog dwara rajya mein teen charanon mein chunav karane ke faisle ka swagat karte hue Ramvilas Paswan ne kaha ki Aayog ne faisla soch-samajhkar kiya hai. BBC ke saath khaas baat-cheet mein Paswan ne kaha ki chunav Aayog ke faisle se kisi party ke fayde ya nuqsan ka sawaal hi nahi uthta. Lekin unhone spasht kiya ki unki party Bharatiya Janata Party aur Rashtriya Janata Dal se samaan doori banakar rakhegi. Shart Paswan ne kaha, "Hum kisi ki taraf haath nahi badhaenge. Humne man bana liya hai ki hum 243 seaton par chunav ladenge. Humne spasht taur par keh diya hai ki RJD aur BJP se hamara koi sambandh nahi rahega." Ramvilas Paswan ne kaha ki agar Janata Dal (United) BJP se naata todti hai, to unse gathbandhan sambhav ho sakta hai. Unhone kaha ki agar Janata Dal (United) aur BJP milkar gathbandhan ka nyota dete hain to ve usmein shamil nahi honge. Paswan ne kaha, "Humne ko shuru mein hi kaha tha ki hum akele chunav ladenge lekin Janata Dal (United) ne kaha tha ki humein saath aana chahiye. Isliye mera kehna hai ki agar Janata Dal (U) naata todkar aana chahe to hum gathbandhan ke liye tayaar hain." Unhone Congress ke saath bhi samjhauta karne ki sambhavana ko kharij nahi kiya aur kaha ki unhe Congress ke saath gathbandhan karke khushi hogi. Congress Paswan ne kaha ki agar Congress RJD ke saath jaane ka faisla karti hai, to ve akele hi chunav ladna pasand karenge. Unhone kaha ki Congress adhyaksha Sonia Gandhi unke vicharon ko achhi tarah jaanti hain. Halanki abhi unki unse koi baat nahi hui hai. Paswan ne is baat se bhi inkaar kiya ki Bihar Vidhan Sabha chunav se sabse bade khiladi ke roop mein ubhrenge. Paswan ne kaha, "Aisa nahi hai. Sab kuch janata ke haath mein hai. Lok Janshakti Party ek saal se Vidhan Sabha chunav ke liye man bana rahi thi. Ab yeh janata ke haath mein hai ki ve kis party ko jitwate hain." Paswan ne kaha ki unki party janata ke beech apni baat lekar jaane ko tayaar hai aur ve Bihar ki sabhi seaton par akele hi chunav ladne ko bhi tayaar hain.
reference: केंद्रीय मंत्री और लोक जनशक्ति पार्टी के अध्यक्ष रामविलास पासवान ने कहा है कि वे बिहार में होने वाले विधानसभा चुनाव में लालू प्रसाद यादव की राष्ट्रीय जनता दल से किसी भी क़ीमत पर गठबंधन नहीं करेंगे.

title: सांस रोके रखने का विश्व रिकॉर्ड
text: Lekin America ke David Blaine ne lagataar 17 minute aur 4 second tak apni saans rok kar rakhne ka vishwa record banaya hai. Chicago mein Oprah Winfrey show mein pradarshan ke dauran Blaine ne yeh vishwa record kayam kiya. David Blaine peshe se jadugar hain. Apne is pradarshan ke dauran Blaine ne khud ko ek badi si kaanch ki gend mein band kar liya tha. Yeh kaanch ki gend poori tarah se paani se bhari hui thi. Paani mein utarne se pehle Blaine ne apne phephdon ko shuddh oxygen se bhara tha aur jism se carbon dioxide ko poori tarah se bahar kar diya tha. Kaise banaya record? Pradarshan ke dauran poore 17 minute 4 second ke dauran Blaine ne khud ko poori tarah tanav-mukt ya 'dhyan' ki sthiti mein rakha tha. Jisse unke sharir ki kam se kam urja kharch ho aur unka jism adhik se adhik shakti ko bacha sake. Isse pehle lagataar itne lambe samay tak saans rokne ka yeh record 16 minute 32 second ka tha. Yeh record isi saal February mein kayam hua tha jise ki Budhwar ko David Blaine ne tod diya. Halankeh, pradarshan ke pehle Blaine ki hriday gati kaafi tez ho gayi thi jiske wajah se wo is show ko karne se bhi peeche hat rahe the. Lekin, baad mein unhone apni hriday gati ko kaabu mein kiya aur yeh record bana dala. Waise, Blaine lagataar 23 minute tak apni saans rok kar naya keertimaan kayam karna chahte the. Show ke baad Blaine ne bataya ki yeh record kayam karna unki zindagi ka ek bada sapna tha. Unhone kaha, "Mujhe shuru mein shak tha ki main ise kar paunga ya nahi. Kyunki, itni tez hriday gati ke saath maine aisa pehle kabhi nahi kiya tha." Paani se bhari kaanch ki is badi si gend mein utarne se pehle David Blaine ne ek 'silver wetsuit' pehna. Is gend mein takriban 8,200 liter paani bhara hua tha. Kamaal ke Blaine 35 saal ke is kamaal ke shakhs se jab show ki host Oprah Winfrey ne poocha ki wo paani ke andar kis ke baare mein soch rahe the to Blaine ka jawab tha 'aapke baare mein'. Blaine ka kehna hai ki unke stunt ya kartab jadoo nahi hain balki, yeh saari cheezein insani jism ki hadon ko charam tak le jaane ki kshamata hai. "Is kamaal mein koi fareb, koi dhokha ya koi chalaki nahi thi." Blaine ke pichle record do saal pehle bhi Blaine ne kuch isi tarah ka ek record banane ki koshish ki thi jisme wo nakam ho gaye the. Is pradarshan ke dauran Blaine ne khud ko paani ke andar zanjeeron se baandh liya tha. Unhe apne aap ko zanjeeron se chhudate hue paani ke andar zyada se zyada der tak paani mein rehna tha. Yeh record nau minute ka tha lekin Blaine ise nahi tod paaye aur unhe 7 minute mein hi upar aana pada. Blaine ne yeh pradarshan America ke shahar New York mein kiya tha. Isi dauran Blaine ne apne aap ko lagataar 7 dino tak paani mein rakhne ka record bhi banaya tha. Waise Blaine kamaal ke aadmi hai aur unhe isi tarah ke kamaal karne ka shauk hai. David Blaine ne khud ko ek hafte ke liye ek taaboot mein band rakhne ka kamaal bhi kar dikhaya tha. Wo ek 100 feet unche khambe par khud ko santulit rakhne ka record bhi bana chuke hain. Blaine khud ko dhai din tak barf mein band karke bhi rakh chuke hain. Isi tarah wo 44 din tak lagataar bina kuch khaye-piye ek bade se bakse mein bhi reh chuke hain. Waise is tarah ke kartab dikhane wale tamaam logon ka kehna hai ki in sabhi pradarshon ko karne ke liye unhe apne 'metabolism' yaani apne sharir ke chayapachay ko sadhana padta hai. Jaise hriday gati ko dheema kar lena, phephdon ki kshamata ko badha lena jisse jism kam se kam oxygen ko sokhe.

title: बलात्कार मामले में न्यायालय का आदेश
text: Mahila sangathanon ne bhi auraton ke viruddh badhti aparaadhik ghatnaon par chinta vyakt ki hai. German nagrik 48 varshiy Sophia (asli naam nahi hai) 11 May ko us waqt do logon ka tab nishana bani jab woh Jodhpur mein apne hotel ja rahi thi. Police ke mutabik Sophia ne ek taxi kiraye par li thi. Lekin taxi chalak aur uska ek saathi Sophia ko ek nirjan sthan par le gaye aur balatkar kiya. Mahila ki cheekh pukar sun kar logon ne taxi chalak par pathraav kiya aur police ko khabar di. Police ne dono ko giraftar kar liya hai. Muaavza Rajasthan uch nyayalay ne khabron ke aadhar par karwai karte hue kaha ki peedit mahila is mukadme ke sambandh mein jab tak Bharat mein rahe tab tak sarkar unka kharch uthane. Adalat ne peedit mahila ki suraksha sunishchit karne aur ek mahine ke samaybandh karyakram mein mukadme ki sunwai poori karne ka aadesh diya. Adalat ne kaha ki peedit mahila ko muaavze ke sawaal par rajya sarkar ko sunne ke baad agle sunwai par vichar kiya ja sakta hai. Uch nyayalay ne ghatna ke baare mein vidhi vigyaan visheshagyon ki report 16 May tak uplabdh karane ko kaha hai. Adalat ne kaha balatkar ek gambhir aparaadh hai, chahe woh kisi ke saath ghatit ho. High Court ne kaha ki aisi ghatna se videshi paryatak mein bhay vyapt ho sakta hai. Udhar Jodhpur ke police adhikshak Ravi Mehrda ne BBC ko bataya ki dono abhyukt ke viruddh Shukravar ko hi adalat mein charge sheet daakhil ki gayi hai. Sophia ab bhi bhaybheet hain aur haadse se ubar nahi paayi hain. Is ghatna se paryatan vyavsaay par bura asar pad sakta hai. Kyunki paryatan Rajasthan ki arthvyavastha ka pramukh hissa hai. Rajya mein prativarsh 6 lakh se zyada videshi sailani aate hain aur desi paryaton ki sankhya 70 lakh se adhik hoti hai. Samajik kary mantri Kavita Srivastav ka kehna tha, "Mukhyamantri, rajyapal aur vidhan sabha adhyaksh - teenon sanvidhanik padon par mahilayein aaseen hain. Lekin isse aurat ki suraksha aur salaamti par koi fark nahi pada hai." Deḍh dashak pehle kathit roop se bal vivaah rokne ke prayason mein samauhik balatkar ki shikar hui Bhawri Devi kehti hain ki halaat jas ke tas hain.
reference: भ्रमण पर आई एक जर्मन महिला के साथ जोधपुर में बलात्कार की घटना को राजस्थान उच्च न्यायालय ने गंभीरता से लेते हुए उन्हें सुरक्षा प्रदान करने और मुक़दमे को एक माह में निपटाने का निर्देश दिया है.

title: 'सिंगुर पर चर्चा उपयोगी और सार्थक'
text: Rajyapal Gopalakrishna Gandhi ki madhyasthata mein hui yeh meeting saade teen ghante chali. Halanki abhi is meeting ka vivaran nahi diya gaya hai lekin rajyapal ne kaha hai ki meeting sarthak aur upyogi rahi hai. Unhone bataya ki agle daur ki baat-cheet shanivaar ko subah 11 baje hogi. Sanket mile hain ki sarkar ne ek vaikalpik prastaav rakha hai. Pehle yeh meeting subah 10 baje se shuru hone wali thi lekin rajyapal ke kehne par ise shaam tak ke liye sthagit kiya gaya tha. Singur mein bhoomi adhigrahan ke mudde par paida hue gatirodh ke kaaran Singur se pratikshit lakhakariya car Nano par bhi sawaal paida ho gaya hai. Agar dono pakshon ke beech koi samjhauta nahi ho pata hai to Tata kisi aur shahar ya rajya mein apni pariyojana ko sthanaantarit kar sakta hai. Meeting Raj Bhavan mein hui is meeting mein sarkar ki or se udyog mantri Nirupam Sen, panchayat mantri Surya Kant Mishra aur mukhya sachiv Amit Kiran Dev maujood the. Udhar Mamata Banerjee ki party Trinamool Congress ki or se vidhan sabha mein pratipaksh ke neta Partho Chattopadhyay sahit teen neta maujood the. Iske alawa rajya sarkar ke kai aala afsar bhi is meeting mein the. Meeting ke baad Partho Chattopadhyay Singur ko ravana hue hain aur unhone kaha hai ki Mamata Banerjee se baat-cheet ke baad hi ve iski jankari media ko denge. Meeting mein maujood adhikaarion ka kehna hai ki meeting ke beech ek samay aisa aaya tha ki Trinamool Congress ke neta meeting chhodkar jaane ko tayaar ho gaye the lekin phir sarkar ne ek vaikalpik prastaav rakha. Trinamool Congress ke neta is vikalp par vichar karne ko tayaar ho gaye hain. Is meeting se pehle rajyapal Gandhi aur mukhyamantri Buddhadeb Bhattacharya ne Mamata Banerjee se Singur mein dharna khatam karne ka anurodh kiya tha. Iske jawab mein Mamata Banerjee ne kaha hai ki unke karyakarta shaantipurn dharna de rahe hain aur ve koi rajneeti nahi kar rahe hain. Wahan baithi Mamata Banerjee painting kar rahi hain. Is beech Durgapur Express Highway ko khaali kar diya gaya hai aur wahan aavagaman shuru ho chuka hai. Vivaad Singur mein Trinamool Congress ke aandolan ko dekhte hue Tata Motors ne Nano car ke nirmaan ka kaam band kar diya hai aur karkhane ke liye vaikalpik jagah ki talash par vichar shuru kar diya hai. Tata samuh ka kehna hai ki karkhane ke paas ki sthitiyan pratikool hain. Aisi ki karmchari kaam par nahi aa rahe hain aur karkhane mein kaamkaj ruka hua hai. Trinamool Congress ki maang hai ki jo kisaan zameen nahi dena chahte hain, unki chaar sau ek acre zameen wapas ki jaye. Halanki Trinamool Congress ka kehna hai ki party nahi chahti hai ki Tata Singur se jaaye, unka kehna hai ki jis zameen par karkhana bana hai, uske liye zameen zabardasti adhigrahit ki gayi hai.
reference: सिंगुर में नैनो कार परियोजना के लिए भूमि अधिग्रहण के मुद्दे पर पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार और ममता बनर्जी के प्रतिनिधियों के बीच बातचीत का एक दौर शुक्रवार की शाम ख़त्म हुआ.

title: हुर्रियत को समय देना चाहिए: मुफ़्ती
text: "BBC ke saath aapki baat" program mein unhone kaha ki unka maanna hai ki aakhirkar Hurriyat ke sabhi guth baatcheet ke liye saamne aayenge. Shrotaon ke sawaalon ke jawab dete hue unhone kaha ki unke paune do saal ke shasan kaal mein Kashmir mein mahaul badla hai aur logon ko aakar ise dekhna chahiye. Chief Minister Syed ne is baat se inkaar kiya ki nayi sarkar ke aane se alagavadi guthon se baatcheet patari se utar gayi hai. Unhone kaha ki nayi sarkar aayi hai aur wo halaat ko jaan samajhkar kaam karegi. Jammu Kashmir ke Chief Minister ne kaha, "Sarkaron mein nirantarata hoti hai aur kendr ki nayi sarkar bhi usi disha mein aage badhegi jis disha mein purani sarkar chal rahi thi." Formula nahi, Bharat-Pakistan ke beech samjhaute ke liye formula ke sawaal par unhone kaha, "Masle ko hal karne se pehle formula nahi banana chahiye, baatcheet se koi formula niklega." Unhone kaha ki dono deshon ki apni neetiyan hain aur hal to baatcheet se hi niklega. Unka kehna tha ki 56 saal purani samasya ke baare mein yeh umeed nahi karni chahiye ki hal ek do mahino mein nikal jayega. Rajya mein Congress se gathbandhan ke baare mein unhone kaha ki matbhed ki choti moti ghatnaayein hoti rehti hain, lekin sab theek chal raha hai. Chief Minister pad ko lekar Congress ke saath samjhaute ke maamle mein unhone kaha ki janta jab chahegi ve pad se utar jayenge. Unhone apne marham lagane ki neeti ka bachav karte hue kaha ki isse Kashmir mein bahut kuch badla hai. Chief Minister ne kaha ki chunavi vaade ke mutabik har parivaar ke ek sadasya ko rozgar dena sanvidhanik roop se sambhav nahi hai.
reference: जम्मू कश्मीर के मुख्यमंत्री मुफ़्ती मोहम्मद सईद का कहना है कि केंद्र की नई सरकार को अलगाववादी संगठन हुर्रियत कांफ्रेंस को कुछ समय देना चाहिए.

title: पाकिस्तान की हिना मुनव्वर इतनी चर्चा में क्यों हैं
text: Hina Munawwar kehti hain ki ek mahila ke roop mein, unhe apni duty ko poori karne mein koi kathinai nahi dikh rahi hai. Chahe unhe field mein jaana ho ya office mein kaam karna ho. Punjab prant ke sheher Faisalabad ki Hina Munawwar ka kehna hai ki Frontier Constabulary Swat mein niyukt kiya jaana unke liye garv ki baat hai kyunki woh ilaake ki behtari ke liye bahut kuch kar sakti hain. Pakistan mein CSS pariksha pass karne ke baad, police seva mein tainaat saat mahilao ko ek varsh ke liye Frontier Constabulary mein tainaat kiya jaayega. Unmein se do ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, chaar ko Islamabad aur ek ko Gilgit mein tainaat kiya gaya hai. In mahilao ki rank mukhya roop se ASP ki hai lekin Frontier Constabulary mein unhe ADO ya sahayak zila adhikari kaha jaata hai. Hina Munawwar ne apna MPhil Development Economics mein poora kiya jiske baad unhone CSS ki pariksha pass ki aur police seva ko prathmikta di aur Pakistan ki Police Service (PPS) mein adhikari niyukt kiya gaya. Unhone kaha ki woh khush hain ki zile mein PPS ka netritva karne wali woh pehli mahila adhikari hain. Hina ne BBC ko bataya ki ek mahila ke roop mein, unhe yeh mehsoos nahi hua ki unhe is bhumika mein koi kathinai ho sakti hai kyunki woh apni khushi aur ichha ke saath is kshetra mein aayi thi. Frontier Constabulary mein ek bhi mahila nahi. Unhone kaha ki woh apni zimmedariyon ko poora karne ki koshish ke saath Swat mein Frontier Constabulary ke sainikon ke kalyan ke liye kuch behtar karengi. Unke anusar, suraksha pratisthan ko aur behtar banana aur anushasan banaye rakhna unki prathmiktaon mein hoga. Ek sawaal ke jawab mein, Hina Munawwar ne kaha ki Pakistan charmpanth se buri tarah prabhavit tha aur Swat mein sthiti behad tanavpurn thi lekin ab sthiti mein sudhar hua hai aur umeed hai ki aage bhi sudhar hoga. Hina shaadishuda hain aur ek bachchi ki maa hain. Unhone kaha ki unke peshe ki apni zarooratein hain. Inke saath apne ghar aur parivaar ko santulit karna hai taaki koi bhi prabhavit na ho aur ise santulit karna ek chunauti hai. Frontier Constabulary mein Deputy Commandant aur police mein atirikta mahanirikshak rahe sewanivrit adhikari Rahmat Khan Wazir ne BBC ko bataya ki Frontier Constabulary ek paramparik police bal raha hai, jiska mukhya kaam qabailon aur sharanarthi bastiyon ke beech ki seema ki nigraani karna tha lekin ab bade badlav kiye ja rahe hain. Kya sochti hain Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki ladkiyan charmpanthik ghatnaon se buri tarah prabhavit ilaaka. Khan ne kaha ki Frontier Constabulary mein mahilao ke shreshth padon par aane se iski karyashaili mein sudhar hone ki umeed hai. Unke anusar, mahilayein karmik record aur vetan record ke alawa Frontier Constabulary mein karyalayik karyon ko behtar tareeke se kar sakti hain. Unhone kaha ki FC mein koi mahila sipahi nahi hai, lekin ab mahila adhikari badi sankhya mein aa rahi hain aur kyunki police ki duty hai, isliye aapat sthiti mein mahilao ko bhaari zimmedariyan nibhani padti hain. Pichle kuch samay se Swat samet Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke adhikansh zile charmpanthik ghatnaon se buri tarah prabhavit rahe hain. Charmpanth se prabhavit rahe Dera Ismail Khan mein kuch ladkiyan kar rahi hain bekhauf reporting. Charmpanth ke khilaf yudh ke dauran, nagrikon aur anya sainik karmiyon aur adhikaron ko nishana banaya gaya. Char Frontier Constabulary police adhikaron samet kul 360 jawanon ko nishana banaya gaya. Frontier Constabulary ki sthaapna 1915 mein Border Military Police aur Samana Rifles ke ekikaran ke saath ki gayi thi. Angrezon ke samay in balon ka kaam seema ki raksha karna tha. Is bal ko mool roop se Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki seema se lage qabaili ilaakon ki raksha ke liye banaya gaya tha, lekin inhe Pakistan ke vibhinn hisson mein tainaat kiya gaya hai. title: किसान आंदोलन: लौट जाएगा किसान संगठनों को विदेश से भेजा गया चंदा?
text: Sangathan ke adhyaksh Joginder Singh Ugarahan ke anusar jin logon ne chanda bheja hai wo videsh mein ya to truck driver ya mazdoor ke roop mein kaam karne wale log hain. Naye krishi kanoon ke khilaf chal rahe aandolan mein Bharatiya Kisan Union (Ekta-Ugarahan) akela sabse bada kisan samuh hai. Is mahine ki shuruaat mein union ne appeal ki thi ki aandolan jaari rakhne ke liye use paison ki zarurat hai. Usne logon se chanda dene ki appeal ki thi. Sangathan ke mahasachiv Sukdev Singh Kokrikalan ne patrakaron se baat karte hue maana ki appeal ke baad logon ne chande ke roop mein aath lakh rupaye sangathan ke khate mein jama kiye. Samapt lekin wo kehte hain ki abhi ye pata nahi hai ki is rakam mein se kitni videsh mein rehne wale kisanon ke parijanon ne bheji hai ya Bharat mein rehne walon ne jama ki hai. Ye rakam Kokrikalan ke khate mein jama hui hai. Registration ki zarurat lekin is beech, sangathan ka kehna hai, "Punjab and Sindh Bank" ke Kokrikalan shakha ke manager ne unhe sarkar ki taraf se bheja gaya notice dikhaya jismein kaha gaya hai ki videsh se bheja gaya chande ka paisa 'Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam' ka ulangan hai kyunki sangathan ne khud ko videsh se prapt hone wale chande ke liye sarkar ke paas panjikrit nahi karaya hai. Jankaron ka kehna hai ki agar panjikaran nahi hota hai to videsh se bheji gayi chande ki rakam bhejne walon ke khaton mein wapas de di jayegi. Institute of Chartered Accountants of India ke Chand Vadhwa ne BBC se baat karte hue bataya ki sirf sangathan hi nahi, agar koi vyakti bhi videsh se rashi le raha hai to use bhi Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam ke tahat khud ko panjikrit karvana hoga. Vadhwa ke anusar rishtedaar ek dusre ko videsh se paise bhej sakte hain jaise beta apne pita ko ya parivaar ko. Usi tarah uphaar ke roop mein bhi paise bheje ja sakte hain lekin jise ye mil rahe hain use ye spasht karna hoga ki kis mad mein ye paise aa rahe hain. Kisan aandolan: Kya Supreme Court ke zariye nikal sakta hai hal? Kisan aandolan ke samarthan mein Obama ne kuch nahi kaha hai. Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam 'Foreign Contribution Regulation Act' yaani Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam ke tahat koi samaj sevi sanstha ya NGO ya sangathan agar videshon se vittiya sahyog ya anudan leti hai to use ye bhi sunishchit karna hoga ki ye anudan samajik karya aur rashtrahit mein hi istemal kiya jayega. Isi saal September mahine mein Grih Mantralaya ne is kanoon mein sanshodhan bhi kiya aur naye sanshodhit Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Sanshodhan Kanoon, 2020 ko Sansad ke Monsoon Satra mein manzoori bhi mili. Mantralaya ne jo is sambandh mein adhishoochna jari ki uske anusar, ab NGO ya sansthaon ke panjikaran ke liye padadhikaron ke aadhar number ko dena anivarya hai. Naye kanoon mein pravadhaan kiye gaye hain ki videshi kosh haasil karne wali sansthaon ko apne prashasanik karyon ke liye kosh ka ab 20 pratishat tak hi kharch karne ki anumati hogi. Kuch mahine pehle kendriya sarkar ne ye kehte hue 'Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam' mein sanshodhan kiye hain ki log videsh se aa rahi rakam ki jankari theek se nahi de rahe hain. Kisan aandolan par Bihar, Odisha, Kerala ke kisanon ne kya kaha? Punjab ki kheti gehu, dhaan aur MSP se aabad ho rahi hai ya barbaad? Britain tak pahucha kisan aandolan notice aa rahe hain... Singhu Border par kisanon ke chal rahe aandolan mein kisan sangathanon ke beech samnvay ka kaam karne wale Parmjeet Singh ne BBC ko bataya ki un logon ko bhi sarkar ke notice milne lage hain jinke rishtedaaron ne unke khaton mein videsh se paise bheje hain. Wo kehte hain, "Hamari jankari mein maamle aa rahe hain ki jo kisan aandolan mein shamil hain unke apne rishtedaar bhi agar unke khate mein paisa bhej rahe hain to unhe bhi notice mil raha hai." Bharatiya Kisan Union (Ekta-Ugarahan) ka kehna hai ki wo is poore maamle mein kanuni salah le rahi hai aur jald hi sarkar ko is baare mein likhit jawab degi. Ugarahan ka kehna hai ki Punjab ke rehne wale NRI agar apni mehnat ki kamai se paise bhej rahe hain to ismein harz kya hai. Chand Vadhwa ka kehna hai ki ismein koi harz nahi hai lekin iski pehle se likhit jankari sarkar ko dena aur apne sangathan ka Videshi Anshdaan (Viniyaman) Adhiniyam ke tahat panjikaran karvana anivarya shart hai. Ye panjikaran Bharat Sarkar ke Grih Mantralaya mein hota hai. Sangathan ne ye zaroor sweekar kiya ki unhone abhi tak panjikaran nahi karwaya hai aur jab wo panjikaran karwana chahte the to iski aakhri tareekh bhi guzar gayi hai. Sangathan ke neta kehte hain ki wo kanuni rai le rahe hain. Wahin Akhil Bharatiya Kisan Sangharsh Samiti ke Sardar VM Singh ne BBC se baat karte hue arop lagaya ki kisanon ke aandolan ko khatm karne ke liye sarkar har tarah ke vikalpon ka istemal kar rahi hai. title: लोगों को जिंदा बचाने की उम्मीद कम
text: Ek adhikari ke mutabik kareeb 1800 logon ke maare jaane ki aashanka hai. Rahat kaam mein lage ek vyakti ne bataya, "Sab kuch daba hua hai, koi vyakti nahi dikha." Bhari barish ke chalte Philippines ke Ginasaugon ilaake mein Shukravaar ko bhuskhlaan hua tha. Bhuskhlaan ke chalte saikron ghar dhah gaye jismein ek school ki imarat bhi shamil hai. Aashanka jataayi ja rahi hai ki school mein us samay vidyarthi maujood the. Rahat karmiyon school mein maujood kareeb 200 chhatron ko dhoondhne ki koshish kar rahe hain lekin unhe kisi ke zinda hone ki umeed kam hi hai. Madad bhuskhlaan ke baad Shukravaar ko kuch hi logon ko zinda nikala gaya tha. Philippines ki rashtrapati ne kaha hai ki 'logon ko aur bhuskhlaanon ke liye tayaar rehna chahiye.' BBC samvaadadata ke mutabik prabhavit ilaake mein koi bhi imarat nazar nahi aa rahi aur keechad ke chalte upkaran bhi theek se kaam nahi kar rahe. Udhar ek American adhikari ne kaha hai ki do American jahaz rahat karyon ke liye Ravivaar ko pahunch jaayenge. Unhone kaha ki America ne upkaran bhi diye hain. Red Cross ne bhi vimaan ke zariye rahat samagri bheji hai. Philippines Red Cross ke pramukh Richard Gordon ne kaha hai, "Hum acche ki umeed kar rahe hain par buri sthiti ke liye bhi khud ko tayaar kar rahe hain." Ek adhikari ne is baat se inkaar kiya hai ki bhuskhlaan jungle kataai ke chalte hua. Samvaaddataon ka kehna hai ki jis ilaake mein bhuskhlaan aaya hai wo har saal aane wale kai toofanon ke raste mein aata hai.
reference: फ़िलीपींस में शुक्रवार को लेयटे इलाक़े में आए भूस्खलन के बाद से और लोगों को जिंदा बचाए जाने की उम्मीद कम होती जा रही है.

title: राम मंदिर निर्माण मुद्दा 'ठंडे बस्ते' में क्यों?
text: Halanki Vishva Hindu Parishad ke antarrashtriya sanyukt mahasachiv Surendra Jain baar-baar is baat par zor dete rahe ki 'andolan sthagit nahi hua' balki ise sirf agle chaar mahine na karne ka nirnay liya gaya hai taaki iska rajneetikaran na ho sake. Saath hi parishad ka maanna hai ki 'secular biradari ko is pavitra andolan ko rajneetik daldaal mein ghasitne ka avsar' na mile isliye woh ise sthagit kar raha hai. Is baat ka zikr Kumbh Dharmasanstha mein Ram Janmabhoomi par ek February ko paas hue prastaav mein bhi hai. Lekin Kumbh mein aur bhi kaafi kuch hua - 13 bade akhadaon se milkar bane Akhada Parishad ne VHP ki Dharmasanstha ka bahishkar karne ka faisla kiya aur khabron ke mutabik Uttar Pradesh ke Mukhyamantri Yogi Adityanath ke maan-manauval ke bawajood bahishkar khatam na karne ko tayaar hue. Akhada Parishad ke pramukh Acharya Narendra Giri ne na sirf Ram Mandir maamle mein VHP ki bhumika par sawaal uthaya balki kendriya sarkar ke us kadam ka bhi virodh kiya jismein gair-vivadit bhoomi ko nyas ko saunpne ki baat kahi gayi hai. Nyas VHP ke adheen hai. Ram Mandir ka rajneetik fayda Angrezi akhbar Times of India ki report ke mutabik Narendra Giri ne kaha, "Kendra chaar saalon tak chup baitha raha aur ab unhone Supreme Court mein arzi daali aur aarop lagaya ki Ram Mandir ka istemal rajneetik fayde ke liye kiya ja raha hai." Ayodhya The Dark Knight naamak kitaab ke sah-lekhak aur varishth patrakar Dheerendra Jha kehte hain, "Ram Mandir nirmaan mein badha ko khatam karne ke naam par RSS aur VHP ne jab kanoon ki maang shuru ki thi tab unhe ye andaaza nahi tha ki pasa ulta pad jayega." RSS pramukh Mohan Bhagwat pichle dinon adalat mein ho rahi deri ki wajah se Hinduo ke dhairya samapt hone aur jald se jald Ram Mandir nirmaan ke liye adhyadesh ya kanoon lane ki maang karte rahe hain. Mandir nirmaan karegi BJP? VHP ne Ram Mandir ko lekar pichle saal se charanbadh tareeke se karyakram kiya hai. Lekin kai vargon se ye bhi sawaal uthte rahe hain ki BJP poorn bahumat se sarkar mein aane par mandir nirmaan ka wada karti rahi hai lekin chaar saalon mein ise lekar koi bada kadam ab tak kyun nahi uthaya gaya. Dheerendra Jha kehte hain, "RSS aur VHP ab ye soch rahi hai ki Ram Mandir maamle ko bhunana to mushkil dikh raha hai to kam se kam BJP ko nuksan se bacha liya jaye aur isi rananiti ke tahat aage badha kadam peeche khicha gaya hai." Sangh kya chahta hai? Hindutva sangathanon ko kareeb se jaanne wale rajneetik vishleshak Jagdish Upasne ka maanna hai ki ismein koi rananiti nahi hai aur Sangh chahta hai ki saara maamla adalat ke madhyam se tay kiya jaye. Woh is sambandh mein RSS ke sar-karyavah Suresh Bhaiyaji Joshi ke us bayan ka hawala dete hain jismein kaha gaya tha ki Ram Mandir ka nirmaan 2025 tak hoga. Jagdish Upasne ye bhi kehte hain ki 'santon ke beech se alag-alag soor uthna koi nayi baat nahi balki aisa pehle bhi hota raha hai, 1990 ke dashak se hi jab mandir andolan zor pakad raha tha.' VHP ka bhi kehna hai ki ho sakta hai kuch sant Kumbh karyakram mein anupasthit rahe hon lekin sadhu-santon aur akhado ke ek bade varg ne Dharmasanstha mein bhaag liya aur prastaavon ka samarthan kiya. Surendra Jain zor dekar kehte hain ki BJP ko is mudde par hone wale fayde-nuksan se VHP ka koi lena-dena nahi hai lekin ye poora maamla backfoot par kaise gaya ye Mohan Bhagwat ke bhashan se saaf ho jata hai. Dharmasanstha mein bolte hue Sangh pramukh Mohan Bhagwat ne kaha tha, "… unko hamare andolan ki kathinai nahi honi chahiye, unko madad honi chahiye aisa hi humein karna padega."
